items.title_en: Split-RL: Local Conflict Resolution in Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: Split-RL：强化学习中的局部冲突消解
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies are often trained by mixing contradictory feedback that is localized in space and time. For example, a robot may prioritize speed in open areas versus precision in tight gaps. We introduce Split-RL, a Gradient Boosting Trees (GBT) algorithm that uses guidance labels to locally isolate these conflicting signals. Standard neural networks (NNs) lack the structural mechanism to do this, as their parameters share feedback from all sources. While GBT provides the inductive bias to explicitly partition the state-space per objective, standard tree-fitting procedures aggregate contradictory gradient signals before they reach the leaves. Split-RL leverages this bias to integrate guidance labels into tree construction, routing these updates into disjoint state-space regions and preventing signal interference. Such labels can arise from heuristics, sensor-derived events, or existing rule-based systems, allowing Split-RL to incorporate rule-derived structure while retaining a learned policy. We theoretically show how early gradient aggregation loses objective-specific information and characterize when the Split-RL score isolates conflicting updates. We focus on constrained RL and offline RL with mixed datasets, each balancing two objectives that conflict locally. Across domains with spatial, rare-event, and temporal conflicts, Split-RL consistently outperforms existing methods by meeting the episodic cost budget while maintaining competitive rewards. In offline settings, Split-RL localizes the tradeoff between imitation and policy improvement, outperforming other methods and achieving near-expert performance across varying dataset sizes.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）策略通常通过混合在空间和时间上局部化的矛盾反馈来训练。例如，机器人可能在开阔区域优先考虑速度，而在狭窄间隙中优先考虑精度。我们提出Split-RL，一种梯度提升树（GBT）算法，利用引导标签在局部隔离这些冲突信号。标准神经网络（NN）缺乏这样做的结构机制，因为其参数共享来自所有来源的反馈。虽然GBT提供了按目标显式划分状态空间的归纳偏置，但标准树拟合过程会在矛盾梯度信号到达叶节点之前将其聚合。Split-RL利用这一偏置，将引导标签整合到树构建中，把这些更新路由到不相交的状态空间区域，防止信号干扰。此类标签可来自启发式规则、传感器派生事件或现有基于规则的系统，使Split-RL能够纳入规则派生结构，同时保留学习到的策略。我们从理论上展示了早期梯度聚合如何丢失目标特定信息，并刻画了Split-RL评分何时隔离冲突更新。我们关注约束RL和具有混合数据集的离线RL，二者各自平衡两个在局部冲突的目标。在具有空间、稀有事件和时间冲突的领域中，Split-RL通过满足情节成本预算同时保持有竞争力的奖励，持续优于现有方法。在离线设置中，Split-RL将模仿与策略改进之间的权衡局部化，优于其他方法，并在不同数据集大小下达到接近专家的性能。

items.title_en: Too Smart for Its Own Good? Cognitive Fidelity and Competence Leakage in LLM Simulations of Young Learners
items.title_zh: 聪明反被聪明误？LLM模拟年轻学习者中的认知保真度与能力泄漏
items.abstract_en: LLM-based interactive learner simulators are increasingly used in educational applications, including teacher training and tutoring system development. A critical requirement for those simulations is cognitive fidelity: the simulated learner should maintain the assigned knowledge, misconceptions, and reasoning procedures throughout interaction. However, LLMs may express knowledge or problem-solving skills beyond the assigned learner's cognitive status, a phenomenon we refer to as competence leakage. In this exploratory study, we examine 3,339 simulated learner utterances from 130 teacher-learner simulator transcripts across three learning scenarios and identify over-competence as a prominent direction of cognitive-profile misalignment during interaction. We then investigate the recurrence of previously observed competence leakage cases under four matched-trigger evaluation protocols, ranging from isolated questioning to multi-turn interactions, across five model configurations. Overall, we observe higher violation recurrence under multi-turn protocols than under isolated question answering. More capable models generally show lower recurrence, whereas increased reasoning effort does not consistently improve cognitive fidelity and is even associated with slightly higher recurrence under multi-turn protocols in our matched-model comparison. These findings provide exploratory evidence of competence leakage phenomena in interactive learner simulation and suggest that single-turn question-answering type of evaluations alone may be insufficient, motivating the development of more systematic and reliable multi-turn protocols for evaluating cognitive fidelity in learner simulation.
items.abstract_zh: 基于LLM的交互式学习者模拟器越来越多地用于教育应用，包括教师培训和辅导系统开发。这些模拟的一个关键要求是认知保真度：模拟学习者应在整个交互过程中保持所分配的知识、误解和推理程序。然而，LLM可能表现出超出所分配学习者认知状态的知识或问题解决技能，我们将这一现象称为能力泄漏。在这项探索性研究中，我们考察了来自130份师生模拟器记录的3,339条模拟学习者话语，涵盖三个学习场景，并将过度能力识别为交互过程中认知画像失配的一个突出方向。然后，我们在四种匹配触发评估协议下（从孤立提问到多轮交互），跨五种模型配置，研究了先前观察到的能力泄漏案例的复现情况。总体而言，我们观察到多轮协议下的违规复现率高于孤立问答。能力更强的模型通常表现出更低的复现率，而在我们的匹配模型比较中，增加推理努力并未一致地提高认知保真度，甚至与多轮协议下略高的复现率相关。这些发现为交互式学习者模拟中的能力泄漏现象提供了探索性证据，并表明仅靠单轮问答类评估可能不足，这促使开发更系统、可靠的多轮协议来评估学习者模拟中的认知保真度。

items.title_en: Toward Agentic Robotics: A Large-Scale Study of Harness Design for Robot-Use Agents
items.title_zh: 迈向智能体机器人：机器人使用智能体的执行框架设计大规模研究
items.abstract_en: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) can act as robot-use agents that understand diverse scenes and control robots through policy code and tools. However, they predict 3D gripper poses poorly even with extended reasoning, struggling with precise manipulation. Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action (WAM) models are the opposite: they execute fast, smooth control on trained tasks, yet fail under domain shifts or when tasks require long-horizon memory and reasoning. Agentic robots therefore combine VLM reasoning and perception with precise VLA/WAM control through a policy harness. Yet harness design spans thousands of configurations, shifting success by tens of points with the same models. Moreover, testing even one design takes thousands of rollouts at high API and GPU cost, so prior works often commit to a single design chosen from few alternatives. To guide harness design, we evaluate over 470,000 rollouts across eight simulation benchmarks, six VLMs, and 15 VLA/WAM checkpoints. Seven controlled studies show effective harnesses must adapt to both VLM and VLA/WAM capabilities. Our findings specify what structure the VLM's policy code needs, where VLA manipulation needs help from tools and policy code, and when to involve the VLM at test time. The reference recipe X-Harness shows that these findings compose without weight updates, lifting base policies up to $+42.8$ points across memory, reasoning, and domain shifts.
items.abstract_zh: 近期的视觉-语言模型（VLM）可作为机器人使用智能体，理解多样场景并通过策略代码和工具控制机器人。然而，即使经过扩展推理，它们对3D夹爪位姿的预测仍然较差，难以完成精确操作。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和世界-动作（WAM）模型则相反：它们在训练过的任务上执行快速、平滑的控制，但在域偏移下或任务需要长时记忆和推理时失败。因此，智能体机器人通过策略执行框架（policy harness）将VLM的推理和感知与精确的VLA/WAM控制相结合。然而，执行框架设计涵盖数千种配置，在相同模型下可使成功率相差数十个百分点。此外，即使测试一种设计也需要数千次rollout，API和GPU成本高昂，因此先前工作通常从少数备选中选定单一设计。为指导执行框架设计，我们在八个模拟基准、六种VLM和15个VLA/WAM检查点上评估了超过470,000次rollout。七项受控研究表明，有效的执行框架必须同时适应VLM和VLA/WAM的能力。我们的发现明确了VLM策略代码需要何种结构、VLA操作在何处需要工具和策略代码的帮助，以及何时在测试时引入VLM。参考配方X-Harness表明，这些发现无需权重更新即可组合，在记忆、推理和域偏移方面将基础策略提升最多$+42.8$个百分点。

items.title_en: One Patch, Many Policies: Object-Associated Physical Patch Attacks on Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: 一个补丁，多种策略：面向机器人操作的物体关联物理补丁攻击
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World Action Models (WAMs) are vulnerable to adversarial visual interference, motivating the study of universal and transferable physical patch attacks. We propose Object-Associated Patch Attack (OAPA), a universal and transferable physical patch framework that enables an attacker to select which task object's manipulation to disrupt through patch placement, without re-optimizing the patch. Our framework combines object-associated placement, differentiable physical compositing, and final action-expert representation divergence. Physical compositing accounts for perspective and occlusion across camera views, while representation divergence guides patch optimization using either relative RMS or cosine distance. Experimental results demonstrate strong attack transferability across task suites and policies, together with the ability to selectively disrupt manipulation of an attacker-chosen task object through patch placement.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和世界动作模型（WAMs）易受对抗性视觉干扰影响，这促使人们研究通用且可迁移的物理补丁攻击。我们提出物体关联补丁攻击（OAPA），这是一个通用且可迁移的物理补丁框架，使攻击者能够通过补丁放置选择干扰哪个任务对象的操作，而无需重新优化补丁。我们的框架结合了物体关联放置、可微物理合成以及最终动作专家表示散度。物理合成考虑跨相机视角的透视和遮挡，而表示散度使用相对 RMS 或余弦距离来指导补丁优化。实验结果表明，该攻击在任务套件和策略之间具有强迁移性，并且能够通过补丁放置选择性地干扰攻击者所选任务对象的操作。

items.title_en: MoHuTS: Developability-Aware Antibody Humanization Using Multi-Objective Tree Search
items.title_zh: MoHuTS：使用多目标树搜索的可开发性感知抗体人源化
items.abstract_en: Antibody humanization aims to reduce the immunogenicity risk associated with non-human antibodies while preserving antigen binding and other properties important for therapeutic development. Identifying suitable framework substitutions often requires repeated rounds of variant construction and experimental testing, making humanization costly. Recently, machine-learning methods, including language models trained on antibody sequences, have been proposed to identify human-like framework substitutions. Although prior humanization methods have considered antigen binding and biophysical properties, it remains challenging to balance humanness across both chains with developability-related properties such as thermal stability and aggregation propensity while retaining favorable parental properties. Here, we present Multi-objective Humanization Tree Search (MoHuTS), which combines an antibody language model with reward-guided tree search to explore combinations of framework substitutions efficiently. Starting from the parental heavy- and light-chain sequences, the language model proposes successive framework substitutions. A combined score for humanness, melting temperature, a structural proxy for binding retention, and aggregation propensity guides the search. Across five computational case studies, MoHuTS generated candidates that showed favorable humanness scores and developability-related properties with relatively few framework substitutions from the parental sequences. These results suggest that MoHuTS can help prioritize humanization candidates for experimental evaluation.
items.abstract_zh: 抗体人源化旨在降低与非人抗体相关的免疫原性风险，同时保留抗原结合以及对治疗开发重要的其他特性。确定合适的框架替换通常需要反复进行变体构建和实验测试，使人源化成本高昂。最近，包括在抗体序列上训练的语言模型在内的机器学习方法已被提出用于识别类人框架替换。尽管先前的人源化方法考虑了抗原结合和生物物理特性，但在两条链上平衡人源性与热稳定性、聚集倾向等可开发性相关特性，同时保留有利的亲本特性，仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出多目标人源化树搜索（MoHuTS），它将抗体语言模型与奖励引导的树搜索相结合，以高效探索框架替换组合。从亲本重链和轻链序列开始，语言模型提出连续的框架替换。由人源性、熔解温度、结合保留的结构代理和聚集倾向组成的综合评分指导搜索。在五个计算案例研究中，MoHuTS生成的候选物在相对亲本序列仅有少量框架替换的情况下，显示出有利的人源性评分和可开发性相关特性。这些结果表明，MoHuTS可帮助优先选择人源化候选物用于实验评估。

items.title_en: Cross-chip transfer in quantum photonic neural networks
items.title_zh: 量子光子神经网络中的跨芯片迁移
items.abstract_en: Fabrication variability makes it difficult to reuse one set of trained parameters across a batch of quantum photonic chips without additional chip-specific optimization. We examine how device-specific compensation and task tolerance shape cross-chip performance. For squared operator loss, local analysis predicts that reducing own-chip error through compensation incurs an increase in expected loss on independent chips. We use Monte Carlo ensemble training (MC-ENS), informed by an available statistical model of fabrication-induced parameter errors. It optimizes one shared parameter set for each task or target at a given fabrication scale by averaging losses over simulated chip realizations resampled from this model. Numerical simulations of a quantum photonic neural network compare MC-ENS with single-chip training, sharpness-aware training and a covariance-informed variant. For CNOT synthesis and Ising dynamics, MC-ENS reduces mean conditional process infidelity and increases mean postselection probability on unseen chips. In classification, high accuracy can persist despite substantial changes in the optical transformation. The decision-margin analysis shows when fabrication-induced score shifts are likely to change predicted labels. The trained shared parameters can be reused without device-specific retraining on unseen chips drawn from the same fabrication distribution.
items.abstract_zh: 制造差异使得在不进行额外芯片特定优化的情况下，很难在一批量子光子芯片上复用同一组训练参数。我们考察器件特定补偿和任务容忍度如何影响跨芯片性能。对于平方算子损失，局部分析预测：通过补偿降低本芯片误差会导致独立芯片上的期望损失增加。我们使用蒙特卡洛集成训练（MC-ENS），其利用可获得的制造诱导参数误差统计模型。该方法通过在从该模型重采样得到的模拟芯片实现上对损失取平均，针对给定制造规模下的每个任务或目标优化一组共享参数。量子光子神经网络的数值仿真将 MC-ENS 与单芯片训练、锐度感知训练以及一种协方差知情变体进行比较。对于 CNOT 合成和 Ising 动力学，MC-ENS 降低了未见芯片上的平均条件过程不保真度，并提高了平均后选择概率。在分类中，尽管光学变换发生显著变化，高准确率仍可保持。决策间隔分析显示了制造诱导的分数偏移何时可能改变预测标签。训练得到的共享参数可在来自同一制造分布的未见芯片上复用，而无需器件特定重新训练。

items.title_en: BRIAR: Martingale Belief Smoothing on Bifurcation-Guided Reasoning Trees
items.title_zh: BRIAR：分岔引导推理树上的鞅信念平滑
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has rapidly advanced long-chain reasoning, yet standard policy optimizers distribute rollout compute and gradient credit blindly across a trajectory. On hard problems, an early misstep derails the remaining trace, whereas on solvable problems, the policy keeps generating redundant verification long after the answer is already determined. We trace both pathologies to a single structural fact: under an on-policy verifier, the true prefix pass probability $V^π(u)$ along a reasoning trace forms a $[0,1]$-bounded Doob martingale whose learnable credit variance is strictly conserved and bounded above by $V^π(u)(1-V^π(u))$, vanishing at both the derailed ($V^π\to 0$) and absorbed ($V^π\to 1$) boundaries. We introduce BRIAR (Bifurcation-guided Rollout and Inference on Adaptive Reasoning trees), a tree-structured RLVR framework built directly around this martingale geometry. First, BRIAR expands discourse-aligned reasoning trees along an upper-confidence outcome-bifurcation frontier, steering rollouts away from absorbed rumination and toward unresolved decision points. Second, it models latent node values with boundary-scaled heteroscedastic edge variances and computes exact global posteriors in linear $\mathcal{O}(|V|)$ time via two-pass Rauch--Tung--Striebel (RTS) tree belief smoothing, eliminating $\mathcal{O}(m^3)$ matrix inversions while gating out spurious boundary noise. Third, BRIAR detects minimal absorbed frontier nodes and applies zero-sum log-length centered suffix advantages strictly post-absorption, leaving pre-absorption derivations provably invariant.
items.abstract_zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已快速推进长链推理，然而标准策略优化器会盲目地在整条轨迹上分配 rollout 计算和梯度信用。在困难问题上，早期失误会使剩余轨迹脱轨；而在可解问题上，策略在答案早已确定后仍会继续生成冗余验证。我们将这两种病态都追溯到一个结构事实：在在线策略验证器下，沿推理轨迹的真实前缀通过概率 V^π(u) 构成一个 [0,1] 有界的 Doob 鞅，其可学习信用方差严格守恒，并由 V^π(u)(1−V^π(u)) 上界约束，在脱轨（V^π→0）和吸收（V^π→1）两个边界处消失。我们提出 BRIAR（Bifurcation-guided Rollout and Inference on Adaptive Reasoning trees），一个直接围绕该鞅几何构建的树结构 RLVR 框架。首先，BRIAR 沿上置信结果分岔前沿扩展与话语对齐的推理树，引导 rollout 远离已吸收的反复思考，转向未解决的决策点。其次，它用边界缩放的异方差边方差建模潜在节点值，并通过两遍 Rauch–Tung–Striebel（RTS）树信念平滑在 O(|V|) 线性时间内计算精确全局后验，消除 O(m³) 矩阵求逆，同时门控掉虚假的边界噪声。第三，BRIAR 检测最小吸收前沿节点，并严格在吸收后应用零和、对数长度居中的后缀优势，使吸收前的推导可证明保持不变。

items.title_en: NORMCRAFT: Cultural Norm Generation for Context-Aware Language Model Alignment
items.title_zh: NORMCRAFT：面向上下文感知语言模型对齐的文化规范生成
items.abstract_en: Cultural alignment requires large language models (LLMs) to infer often-implicit social norms from a scenario and its cultural context. Existing approaches typically adapt individual models or supply external cultural knowledge, while learning norm inference independently of downstream response generation remains underexplored. We introduce NORMCRAFT, a modular framework that decouples norm inference from response generation. Through norm-centric multi-view supervision, we train an LLM as a norm generator to recover shared norms from prospective, adherence, and violation scenarios without downstream response labels. The generated norms guide a separate, frozen LLM (the responder). With Qwen3.5-4B as the responder, NORMCRAFT outperforms prompting and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines on four of five downstream metrics. On SafeWorld, its responses reflect the reference norms more often (Coverage) and more precisely (Faithfulness), exceeding Responder SFT by 18.0 and 14.1 percentage points, respectively. Direct norm evaluation also shows higher norm quality than the base and few-shot generators. The same trained generator improves cultural alignment on SafeWorld across fourteen frozen LLMs spanning five families and 0.8B to 27B parameters, with the largest gains for the smallest models.
items.abstract_zh: 文化对齐要求大语言模型（LLMs）从场景及其文化语境中推断往往隐含的社会规范。现有方法通常适配单个模型或提供外部文化知识，而独立于下游响应生成来学习规范推断仍未得到充分探索。我们提出 NORMCRAFT，一个将规范推断与响应生成解耦的模块化框架。通过以规范为中心的多视图监督，我们训练一个 LLM 作为规范生成器，在没有下游响应标签的情况下从预期、遵守和违反场景中恢复共享规范。生成的规范指导另一个冻结的 LLM（响应器）。以 Qwen3.5-4B 作为响应器，NORMCRAFT 在五个下游指标中的四个上优于提示和监督微调（SFT）基线。在 SafeWorld 上，其响应更经常（Coverage）且更精确（Faithfulness）地反映参考规范，分别超过响应器 SFT 18.0 和 14.1 个百分点。直接规范评估也显示出比基础生成器和少样本生成器更高的规范质量。同一个训练后的生成器在 SafeWorld 上提升了十四个冻结 LLM 的文化对齐，这些模型跨越五个家族、参数规模从 0.8B 到 27B，其中最小模型增益最大。

items.title_en: RoboEvo$^2$: Recursive Robot Self-Improvement via Harness-Policy Co-Evolution
items.title_zh: RoboEvo$^2$：通过 Harness-Policy 协同进化的递归机器人自我改进
items.abstract_en: Robots should adapt to unfamiliar environments and acquire new skills through interaction, then execute those skills efficiently with practice. Vision-language-action policies provide efficient control, but often need additional human demonstrations to handle unfamiliar settings; reasoning agents can discover solutions using broad prior knowledge and robot-control APIs, but repeated deliberation and repair are costly. Inspired by human learning through reasoning and practice, we propose RoboEvo$^2$, a framework for recursive harness-policy co-evolution. In Policy-to-Harness (P2H) evolution, policy failures guide a coding agent to search complementary Code, Code+ICL, and Code+Policy routes, consolidating verified solutions into reusable skills, routing strategies, and experience memory. In Harness-to-Policy (H2P) evolution, verified trajectories provide supervised training, while Counterfactual Preference Distillation (CPD) teaches the policy to favor successful corrections over failures from the same starting state. The improved policy provides stronger motor skills for subsequent search, while its remaining failures redirect harness evolution, closing the reciprocal loop. Through recursive co-evolution without additional human demonstrations, RoboEvo$^2$ improves standalone success from 11.0% to 84.1% and hybrid success from 30.4% to 90.5% on LIBERO-PRO, with similar gains and reduced agentic costs on RoboTwin C2R. Further experiments demonstrate autonomous task acquisition, cross-embodiment harness transfer, and 95.0% hybrid success on the Unitree G1-D. Our models and code will be publicly released.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人应适应陌生环境并通过交互获得新技能，然后通过练习高效执行这些技能。视觉-语言-动作策略提供高效控制，但通常需要额外的人类示范来处理陌生环境；推理智能体可以利用广泛的先验知识和机器人控制 API 发现解决方案，但反复推理和修复代价高昂。受人类通过推理和实践学习的启发，我们提出 RoboEvo$^2$，一个用于递归 Harness-Policy 协同进化的框架。在 Policy-to-Harness（P2H）进化中，策略失败引导编码智能体搜索互补的 Code、Code+ICL 和 Code+Policy 路线，将经验证的解决方案整合为可复用技能、路由策略和经验记忆。在 Harness-to-Policy（H2P）进化中，经验证的轨迹提供监督训练，而反事实偏好蒸馏（CPD）教会策略在相同起始状态下更偏好成功的修正而非失败。改进后的策略为后续搜索提供更强的运动技能，而其剩余失败则重新引导 Harness 进化，闭合互惠循环。通过无需额外人类示范的递归协同进化，RoboEvo$^2$ 在 LIBERO-PRO 上将独立成功率从 11.0% 提升到 84.1%，将混合成功率从 30.4% 提升到 90.5%，并在 RoboTwin C2R 上取得类似增益且降低智能体成本。进一步实验展示了自主任务获取、跨本体 Harness 迁移，以及在 Unitree G1-D 上达到 95.0% 的混合成功率。我们的模型和代码将公开发布。

items.title_en: Embodied-VGGT: Preserving Reliable Local Geometry for Long-Sequence Reconstruction
items.title_zh: Embodied-VGGT：为长序列重建保留可靠的局部几何
items.abstract_en: Long sequence reconstruction must correct accumulated drift while preserving locally consistent geometry. In robotics and autonomous driving, embodied acquisition provides recurring platform- environment geometry and repeated observations of scene structure and platform motion. We present Embodied-VGGT, which exploits these cues to establish reliable local relationships and selectively preserve them during global refinement. Memory-Augmented Grounded Chunks (MAGC) builds on Scal3R's global context memory and uses relative scale references derived from predicted ground geometry to regularize test-time memory updates, encouraging cross-chunk consistency while limiting changes to reliable local geometry. Superpoint Alignment (SA) and Cross-Loop Optimization (CL) jointly address the robust establishment and preservation of geometric relationships. SA balances ground and non-ground evidence across spatial regions to estimate inter-chunk translation. CL uses geometric and motion consistency across interleaved windows to select coherent chunk groups, each receiving a shared Sim(3) correction that preserves its internal relative transformations during global optimization. Experiments on five public driving benchmarks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements in long sequence reconstruction. On KITTI Odometry, Embodied-VGGT achieves a mean absolute trajectory error of 7.30 m and a Chamfer distance of 2.67 m, reducing these errors by 46.8% and 23.3% compared with the state-of-the-art baseline under same evaluation protocol. To facilitate reproducibility, we released our code: https://github.com/Ang-Sheep/Embodied-VGGT.
items.abstract_zh: 长序列重建必须在纠正累积漂移的同时保留局部一致的几何。在机器人和自动驾驶中，具身采集提供了重复出现的平台—环境几何，以及场景结构和平台运动的重复观测。我们提出 Embodied-VGGT，利用这些线索建立可靠的局部关系，并在全局优化过程中选择性保留它们。记忆增强接地块（Memory-Augmented Grounded Chunks, MAGC）建立在 Scal3R 的全局上下文记忆之上，利用由预测地面几何得到的相对尺度参考来正则化测试时记忆更新，促进跨块一致性，同时限制对可靠局部几何的改动。超级点对齐（Superpoint Alignment, SA）与跨回环优化（Cross-Loop Optimization, CL）共同解决几何关系的稳健建立与保留。SA 在空间区域间平衡地面与非地面证据，以估计块间平移。CL 利用交错窗口间的几何与运动一致性选择连贯的块组，每组获得共享的 Sim(3) 校正，在全局优化期间保留其内部相对变换。在五个公开驾驶基准上的实验表明，长序列重建取得一致且显著的改进。在 KITTI Odometry 上，Embodied-VGGT 达到 7.30 m 的平均绝对轨迹误差和 2.67 m 的 Chamfer 距离，在相同评估协议下相比最先进基线分别降低 46.8% 和 23.3%。为便于复现，我们发布了代码：https://github.com/Ang-Sheep/Embodied-VGGT。

items.title_en: AI-Driven Prediction of Drug-Target Interactions for New Chemical Entities
items.title_zh: AI驱动的全新化学实体药物-靶点相互作用预测
items.abstract_en: BackgroundModels that Ranking compounds may improve efficiency in drug discovery; however, due to similar chemistry in train/test sets, performance is often measured using random data splits. Here, we assess the predictive performance on completely novel compounds. MethodExact Ki values from BindingDB v202609 were used to create a dataset of 421,968 unique ligand-protein interactions. Interactions were defined as active if Ki [≤] 100 nM (53% active). Fingerprints (MACCS, ECFP4/ECFP6), six physicochemical properties, nine ADMET-AI predicted properties and amino acid composition of proteins were used as features, and interactions were classified with XGBoost. Thresholds were optimised on the validation set. External validation was performed using 1,524 target-compound pairs with no exact match in BindingDB. Compounds were defined as active if pChEMBL [≥] 6. ResultsUsing all three fingerprints, the best performance was achieved with ECFP6 (ROC-AUC 0.9125 [95%CI: 0.9105-0.9145], PR-AUC 0.9222, MCC 0.6613) on 84,394 hidden interactions. Performance dropped significantly on external validation with novel compounds. The lowest drop was seen with ECFP6, with ROC-AUC 0.8040 and MCC 0.4701. All three fingerprints showed a decrease in performance. Performance decreased significantly (by [~]0.11 ROC-AUC and [~]0.19 MCC) when applied to novel compounds compared to performance in random splits. Uncertainty in performance is much less ([~]{+/-}0.02). ConclusionGradient boosting using fingerprints retains some predictive performance in novel compounds. However, performance in random splits overestimates performance in external validation. This is due to several factors including chemical novelty, mismatch between classes and mismatch between ADMET features in train/validation sets. This is discussed
items.abstract_zh: 背景：对化合物进行排序的模型可能提高药物发现效率；然而，由于训练/测试集中化学结构相似，性能通常使用随机数据划分来衡量。在此，我们评估对完全新化合物的预测性能。方法：使用BindingDB v202609中的精确Ki值创建包含421,968个独特配体-蛋白相互作用的数据集。若Ki ≤ 100 nM（53%为活性），则相互作用定义为活性。使用指纹（MACCS、ECFP4/ECFP6）、六种理化性质、九种ADMET-AI预测性质以及蛋白质的氨基酸组成作为特征，并用XGBoost对相互作用进行分类。阈值在验证集上优化。使用1,524个在BindingDB中没有精确匹配的靶点-化合物对进行外部验证。若pChEMBL ≥ 6，则化合物定义为活性。结果：使用全部三种指纹时，ECFP6在84,394个隐藏相互作用上取得最佳性能（ROC-AUC 0.9125 [95%CI: 0.9105-0.9145]，PR-AUC 0.9222，MCC 0.6613）。在全新化合物的外部验证中，性能显著下降。下降最小的是ECFP6，ROC-AUC为0.8040，MCC为0.4701。三种指纹均显示性能下降。与随机划分中的性能相比，应用于新化合物时性能显著下降（约0.11 ROC-AUC和约0.19 MCC）。性能的不确定性要小得多（约±0.02）。结论：使用指纹的梯度提升在全新化合物中保留了一定的预测性能。然而，随机划分中的性能高估了外部验证中的性能。这归因于若干因素，包括化学新颖性、类别之间的不匹配以及训练/验证集中ADMET特征之间的不匹配。本文对此进行了讨论。

items.title_en: PerovAgent: Autonomous Ligand Design for Halide Perovskite Nanocrystals
items.title_zh: PerovAgent：卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶的自主配体设计
items.abstract_en: Designing surface-capping ligands for high-performance halide perovskite nanocrystals requires navigating a vast molecular space while discovering design rules that govern ligand-surface interactions. Here, we introduce PerovAgent, an autonomous multi-agent framework that combines large language model (LLM)-driven scientific reasoning with computational tools for atomistic model construction, machine-learned interatomic potential evaluation, and statistical validation. Across ten independent campaigns on CsPbBr3 surfaces, PerovAgent adaptively explored and refined diverse ligand chemistries while progressively improving the binding-energy objective. Beyond optimization, the framework converts recurring chemical observations into explicit design principles that can be statistically evaluated. Of 35 formulated principles, 19 were prospectively supported, of which seven also passed the confound audit, highlighting the need to systematically validate plausible LLM-generated hypotheses during autonomous discovery. A recurrent alkynyl-phosphonate principle was further examined using density functional theory, which reproduced the predicted energetic preference. These results demonstrate an autonomous discovery framework that not only searches molecular space and optimizes the scalar objective but also transforms its search trajectory into systematically testable design principles. The framework can also be extended to more complex ligands, including zwitterionic, multidentate, and polymerizable ligands, to explore a wider range of ligand-surface interactions and uncover new design principles for halide perovskite nanocrystals.
items.abstract_zh: 为高性能卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶设计表面封装配体，需要在广阔分子空间中导航，同时发现支配配体—表面相互作用的设计规则。在此，我们提出 PerovAgent，一个自主多智能体框架，将大语言模型（LLM）驱动的科学推理与用于原子模型构建、机器学习原子间势评估和统计验证的计算工具相结合。在 CsPbBr3 表面上的十次独立实验活动中，PerovAgent 自适应地探索和精炼多样配体化学，同时逐步改善结合能目标。除优化外，该框架将反复出现的化学观察转化为可统计评估的显式设计原则。在提出的 35 条原则中，19 条获得前瞻性支持，其中 7 条还通过了混杂因素审计，突显了在自主发现过程中系统验证看似合理的 LLM 生成假设的必要性。使用密度泛函理论进一步检验了一条反复出现的炔基—膦酸酯原则，复现了预测的能量偏好。这些结果表明，一个自主发现框架不仅能搜索分子空间并优化标量目标，还能将其搜索轨迹转化为可系统检验的设计原则。该框架还可扩展到更复杂的配体，包括两性离子、多齿和可聚合配体，以探索更广泛的配体—表面相互作用，并揭示卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶的新设计原则。

items.title_en: Distractor-Robust Reinforcement Learning via Variational Bisimulation
items.title_zh: 通过变分双模拟实现抗干扰强化学习
items.abstract_en: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) promises data efficiency and generalization, but typical reconstruction-based objectives encourage models to waste representational capacity on task-irrelevant distractors. We introduce VIBES (Variational Inference for Bisimulation-based Encoded States), a new objective that replaces pixel reconstruction with an adversarial term, which enforces that latent states suffice to predict both rewards and the next latent state. We show that this objective measures how far the encoder is from reward and dynamics sufficiency, and that whenever exact sufficiency is attainable, its global optima induce bisimulation relations on histories. Combined with a fixed-capacity latent bottleneck, this encourages latent states to retain task-relevant information while discarding irrelevant variation. Our method serves as a drop-in replacement for Dreamer's model-learning component, achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Distracting Control Suite, and extends to visually complex manipulation in Realistic ManiSkill. Unlike prior approaches, it does not rely on image-specific augmentations and applies equally well to high-dimensional vector-state tasks, demonstrated on a 100-link swimmer robot. Finally, latent-space analyses (UMAP embeddings and nearest-neighbor probes) confirm that the learned representations are sensitive to task-relevant structure while invariant to distractors.
items.abstract_zh: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）有望提升数据效率与泛化能力，但典型的基于重构的目标鼓励模型将表征能力浪费在与任务无关的干扰因素上。我们提出VIBES（用于双模拟编码状态的变分推断），一种新的目标，用对抗项替代像素重构，强制潜状态足以预测奖励和下一潜状态。我们表明该目标衡量编码器距离奖励充分性和动力学充分性有多远，并且只要能够达到精确充分性，其全局最优解就在历史上诱导双模拟关系。结合固定容量潜变量瓶颈，这鼓励潜状态保留任务相关信息而丢弃无关变化。我们的方法可作为Dreamer模型学习组件的直接替换，在Distracting Control Suite上取得最先进性能，并扩展到Realistic ManiSkill中视觉复杂的操作任务。与先前方法不同，它不依赖图像特定的增强，并且同样适用于高维向量状态任务，并在100连杆游泳机器人上得到演示。最后，潜空间分析（UMAP嵌入和最近邻探测）证实所学表征对任务相关结构敏感，同时对抗干扰因素不变。

items.title_en: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis in Jacobian-Space: Language and Vision Models Agree Approximately Up to a Rotation
items.title_zh: 雅可比空间中的柏拉图表示假说：语言与视觉模型在旋转意义下近似一致
items.abstract_en: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) posits that AI models converge toward a shared representation of the world, even when trained on different data modalities. Previous work has found evidence for the PRH in the activations of vision and language models. In this work, we ask whether vision and language models also converge in how they act on these representations: precisely, in how these internal representations affect the models' output. At a chosen layer of a transformer, the Jacobian lens gives every word in the vocabulary (or class in an image classifier) a vector in the hidden state: the vector that most increases the model's tendency to generate that word, at that position or later, or to predict that class. Collectively, these vectors make up what is referred to as the model's J-space. We find evidence of the PRH in J-space across vision and language models, and furthermore, we find that J-spaces mostly converge up to a rotation. That is, a single rotation, fitted on a subset of words, approximately maps one model's J-space onto another's, and so applies to words and classes it was not fitted on. A word's vector, rotated from a text-only language model's J-space into the visual patch tokens of a vision-language model, changes the object the vision-language model says is in the image (and only in the image region where it is added). Rotated into an image generator's text conditioning, a word's vector changes the object in the generated image. Rotated into an ImageNet classifier (trained without text), it raises that object's class score above almost all others, and vice versa. This suggests that models converge not only in how they represent the world, but also in how they act on it.
items.abstract_zh: 柏拉图表示假说（PRH）认为，即使在不同数据模态上训练，AI 模型也会收敛到共享的世界表示。先前工作已在视觉和语言模型的激活中找到 PRH 的证据。在本工作中，我们追问视觉和语言模型是否也在作用于这些表示的方式上收敛：确切地说，这些内部表示如何影响模型输出。在 Transformer 的选定层，雅可比透镜为词汇表中的每个词（或图像分类器中的每个类）在隐藏状态中给出一个向量：该向量最能提高模型在该位置或之后生成该词的倾向，或预测该类别的倾向。这些向量共同构成所谓模型的 J 空间。我们在视觉和语言模型的 J 空间中找到 PRH 的证据，并且发现 J 空间大多在旋转意义下收敛。也就是说，一个在词子集上拟合的单一旋转可近似地将一个模型的 J 空间映射到另一个模型的 J 空间，因此也适用于未参与拟合的词和类别。将一个词的向量从纯文本语言模型的 J 空间旋转到视觉语言模型的视觉 patch 词元中，会改变视觉语言模型所说图像中的物体（且仅在添加该向量的图像区域）。旋转到图像生成器的文本条件中，词的向量会改变生成图像中的物体。旋转到 ImageNet 分类器（未用文本训练）中，它会将该物体的类别分数提高到几乎高于所有其他类别，反之亦然。这表明模型不仅在表示世界的方式上收敛，也在作用于世界的方式上收敛。

items.title_en: End-to-End Image-Goal Navigation for Agile Quadrotors via Recurrent State Distillation
items.title_zh: 通过循环状态蒸馏实现敏捷四旋翼的端到端图像目标导航
items.abstract_en: Image-goal navigation asks a robot to reach the viewpoint of a target photograph without a map or goal pose. In three dimensions, this requires not only recognizing the goal but also estimating 3D displacement and generating continuous control actions to approach and settle at the target view. This is difficult because the same visual difference between current and goal image can require very different actions depending on the robot's velocity, yet monocular images alone reveal neither metric scale nor body motion. As a result, existing image-goal policies are limited to planar action spaces and rely on a state estimator for flight control. Policies that map directly from images to low-level control commands have been demonstrated for agile flight, but not toward goal images in unseen environments. We present the first image-goal navigation policy that directly commands thrust and angular rates for agile quadrotor flight in unseen 3D environments, without relying on state estimation (e.g., SLAM, VO, or SfM) or a separate velocity controller. We train a recurrent vision-based policy through a four-stage pipeline that combines geometric and motion supervision with privileged-teacher distillation and end-to-end reinforcement learning fine-tuning. On 1000 held-out flights in unseen environments, the policy achieves an 82.3% success rate with a mean terminal position error of 0.10m across successful flights. Deployed zero-shot on a real quadrotor, the policy reaches an 84% success rate over 25 trials in an unseen indoor environment.
items.abstract_zh: 图像目标导航要求机器人在没有地图或目标位姿的情况下到达目标照片的视点。在三维中，这不仅需要识别目标，还需要估计三维位移并生成连续控制动作，以接近并稳定在目标视图。这很困难，因为当前图像与目标图像之间相同的视觉差异可能因机器人速度不同而需要非常不同的动作，而单目图像本身既不揭示度量尺度也不揭示机体运动。因此，现有图像目标策略局限于平面动作空间，并依赖状态估计器进行飞行控制。直接从图像映射到低级控制指令的策略已在敏捷飞行中展示，但尚未在未见环境中朝向目标图像展示。我们提出首个图像目标导航策略，在未见三维环境中直接为敏捷四旋翼飞行指令推力和角速率，而不依赖状态估计（如 SLAM、VO 或 SfM）或单独的速度控制器。我们通过四阶段流程训练循环视觉策略，该流程将几何与运动监督与特权教师蒸馏以及端到端强化学习微调相结合。在未见环境中的 1000 次留出飞行中，该策略达到 82.3% 的成功率，成功飞行的平均终端位置误差为 0.10m。在真实四旋翼上零样本部署时，该策略在未见室内环境中的 25 次试验中达到 84% 的成功率。

items.title_en: DriftWAM: Faster World-Action Models via Action-Aware Video Drifting
items.title_zh: DriftWAM：通过动作感知视频漂移实现更快的世界-动作模型
items.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) unify future video prediction and action generation for robotic control, but their reliance on iterative denoising incurs substantial inference costs. Distilling these models into few-step generators offers a promising route to efficient deployment, yet maintaining task performance under aggressive step reduction remains challenging. Existing methods rely on point-wise trajectory consistency distillation, which pursues high visual fidelity while leaving downstream action information unexploited in optimizing video generation, and also lacks explicit distribution-level alignment. To address this, we propose DriftWAM, a few-step WAM distillation framework that incorporates the actions induced by predicted videos into video learning. Specifically, DriftWAM integrates action-aware video drifting, which performs video distribution matching through a joint visual--action similarity kernel to steer sample evolution under the guidance of these induced actions, with action-guided video regularization, which leverages the compatible teacher--student matches identified by the joint kernel to backpropagate action-level gradients directly into the video generator. Evaluations on the RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO benchmarks, as well as in real-world robotic manipulation tasks, show that DriftWAM consistently outperforms prior consistency distillation methods across few-step settings at the same inference speed.
items.abstract_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAM）将未来视频预测与动作生成统一用于机器人控制，但其对迭代去噪的依赖带来显著推理成本。将此类模型蒸馏为少步生成器是实现高效部署的有前景途径，但在激进减少步数下保持任务性能仍具挑战。现有方法依赖逐点轨迹一致性蒸馏，在优化视频生成时追求高视觉保真度，却未利用下游动作信息，也缺乏显式的分布级对齐。为此，我们提出DriftWAM，一种少步WAM蒸馏框架，将预测视频所诱导的动作纳入视频学习。具体而言，DriftWAM集成动作感知视频漂移，通过联合视觉-动作相似度核执行视频分布匹配，在这些诱导动作的引导下驱动样本演化；并引入动作引导视频正则化，利用联合核识别出的兼容教师-学生匹配，将动作级梯度直接反传至视频生成器。在RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO基准以及真实机器人操作任务上的评估表明，在相同推理速度下，DriftWAM在多种少步设置中始终优于先前的一致性蒸馏方法。

items.title_en: Deep Learning-Guided Design of Candidate Synthetic Cis-Regulatory Elements for a TCF7+ Progenitor-Exhausted-like CD8+ T-Cell State
items.title_zh: 深度学习指导设计针对TCF7+祖细胞耗竭样CD8+ T细胞状态的候选合成顺式调控元件
items.abstract_en: Progenitor-exhausted CD8+ T cells (Tex-prog) are essential for sustaining T-cell-mediated immunity during chronic infection and cancer and therefore offer a promising immunotherapy target. Synthetic cis-regulatory elements (CREs) could enable selective transgene expression in Tex-prog cells, but whether they can distinguish this population from closely related CD8+ T-cell exhaustion states remains unclear. Here, we integrated publicly available paired single-cell ATAC-seq and single-cell RNA-seq datasets from mouse infection and tumor models and identified an ATAC-defined Tex-prog-like population (C1). We used the CREsted framework to fine-tune a pretrained Borzoi model to predict chromatin accessibility across C1 and ten comparator populations. We then used CREsted to design candidate synthetic CREs with predicted preferential accessibility in C1. The fine-tuned model achieved an average precision of 0.242 for identifying C1-selective regions on chromosomes held out from fine-tuning, approximately tenfold higher than the random-ranking baseline. Sequence optimization generated 196 1,000-bp designs with at least twofold higher predicted accessibility in C1 relative to the strongest competing population across eight DNA backgrounds. Motif enrichment and sequence-attribution analyses identified sequence patterns associated with AP-1, NFAT, POU, EGR, and TCF/LEF transcription factor families. Together, these findings identify candidate synthetic CREs with predicted preferential accessibility in a Tex-prog-like CD8+ T-cell population and provide a foundation for future experimental evaluation of their functional enhancer activity and cell-state specificity.
items.abstract_zh: 祖细胞耗竭型CD8+ T细胞（Tex-prog）对于在慢性感染和癌症期间维持T细胞介导的免疫至关重要，因此提供了有前景的免疫治疗靶点。合成顺式调控元件（CREs）可能实现Tex-prog细胞中的选择性转基因表达，但它们能否将该群体与密切相关的CD8+ T细胞耗竭状态区分开来仍不清楚。在此，我们整合了来自小鼠感染和肿瘤模型的公开配对单细胞ATAC-seq和单细胞RNA-seq数据集，并鉴定出一个由ATAC定义的Tex-prog样群体（C1）。我们使用CREsted框架微调预训练的Borzoi模型，以预测C1和十个比较群体中的染色质可及性。然后，我们使用CREsted设计在C1中预测具有优先可及性的候选合成CREs。微调后的模型在从微调中留出的染色体上识别C1选择性区域的平均精度为0.242，约为随机排序基线的十倍。序列优化生成了196个1,000-bp设计，在八种DNA背景下，其在C1中的预测可及性至少比最强的竞争群体高两倍。基序富集和序列归因分析鉴定了与AP-1、NFAT、POU、EGR和TCF/LEF转录因子家族相关的序列模式。总之，这些发现鉴定了在Tex-prog样CD8+ T细胞群体中预测具有优先可及性的候选合成CREs，并为其功能增强子活性和细胞状态特异性的未来实验评估提供了基础。

items.title_en: Transport Layer-Driven Optimization of Color and Efficiency in TADF OLEDs for Large-Area Applications
items.title_zh: 面向大面积应用的TADF OLED中传输层驱动的颜色与效率优化
items.abstract_en: Balancing structural simplicity with high efficiency is crucial for practical applications of organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs), especially in large-area lighting devices. Optimizing the charge-transport layers in multilayer OLEDs controls the recombination zone within the emissive layer, thereby enhancing the device's performance. Herein, we experimentally and computationally investigate how the thicknesses of the electron and hole transport layers affect the performance of orange-red thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF) OLEDs. Using a TADF emitter, 2-[4-(diphenylamino)phenyl]-10,10-dioxide-9H-thioxanthen-9-one (TXO-TPA), at 10 wt\% concentration in 4,4-Bis(N-carbazolyl)-1,1-biphenyl (CBP) host, we achieve a maximum external quantum efficiency ($η_{EQE}$) of 20.86\% and a peak luminance of 32,800 cd m$^{-2}$. Using a combination of drift-diffusion and optical simulations, we reveal how variations in hole- and electron-transport-layer thicknesses modulate the charge-carrier balance and shift the recombination zone within the emissive layer. This tuning not only optimizes exciton formation but also enables color tuning from green to red without altering the emissive material. Our findings highlight the critical role of transport layer engineering in achieving efficient, color-controlled OLEDs with simplified architectures. Furthermore, we successfully demonstrate a large-area OLED device (~20 cm$^{2}$), achieving an impressive $η_{EQE}$ of 17\%, underscoring the scalability and practicality of our approach for general lighting applications.
items.abstract_zh: 在结构简洁性与高效率之间取得平衡对于有机发光二极管（OLED）的实际应用至关重要，尤其是在大面积照明器件中。优化多层OLED中的电荷传输层可控制发光层内的复合区，从而提升器件性能。本文通过实验与计算研究电子传输层和空穴传输层的厚度如何影响橙红色热活化延迟荧光（TADF）OLED的性能。使用TADF发光体2-[4-(二苯氨基)苯基]-10,10-二氧化-9H-噻吨-9-酮（TXO-TPA），在4,4-双(N-咔唑基)-1,1-联苯（CBP）主体中以10 wt%浓度掺杂，我们实现了20.86%的最大外量子效率（η_EQE）和32,800 cd m^-2的峰值亮度。结合漂移-扩散与光学模拟，我们揭示了空穴传输层和电子传输层厚度的变化如何调制电荷载流子平衡并移动发光层内的复合区。这种调控不仅优化激子形成，还能在不改变发光材料的情况下实现从绿色到红色的颜色调谐。我们的发现凸显了传输层工程在实现结构简化且高效、颜色可控的OLED中的关键作用。此外，我们成功展示了一个大面积OLED器件（约20 cm^2），实现了17%的η_EQE，凸显了该方法在通用照明应用中的可扩展性与实用性。

items.title_en: Spec2Weights: Certifying Networks that a Language Model Writes from a Specification
items.title_zh: Spec2Weights：认证语言模型根据规范写出的网络
items.abstract_en: A language model can write the weights of a small MLP, CNN, RNN or GNN from a plain-language specification, with no data and no gradient step. We ask when such a network can be proved exact in the float32 arithmetic it actually runs in. A float-safety lemma makes exhaustive float32 enumeration a proof for any summation order, and a layered error bound covers networks whose weights are not short binary fractions. With dynamic programming, template checks, an SMT proof, breadth-first search and induction for weight-tied recurrences, this certifies 12 of 15 written networks (one after a single constant fix) on every input of a stated domain (up to $10^{16}$ inputs, or every graph or grid up to a size bound), in a minute of CPU or less each. The certificates also say where a network stops being exact: the shortest-path network is exact iff the distance is at most 4,096 and fails at the predicted hops. Thirty new specifications were each written by a fresh session of one model family (Claude Opus 5.5). Twenty-five first submissions are certified exact for any summation order; the five tax schedules stay within \$0.11 of the true tax at every whole dollar in one fixed float32 run. An open 27B model passes 23 of the 30, and 25 with more thinking and code execution, so the method transfers in part. We also prove two limits of learning from examples: input coordinates never active in training cannot be learned from more in-range data, and Luhn-type checksums have exponentially small target-dependent gradient variance across their family. Tuned gradient descent on the same architectures agrees with both, which cover two of our five failure classes.
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型可以根据纯语言规范写出小型 MLP、CNN、RNN 或 GNN 的权重，无需数据也无需梯度步骤。我们追问：何时能证明这样的网络在其实际运行的 float32 算术中是精确的。一个浮点安全性引理使穷举 float32 枚举成为对任意求和顺序的证明，而分层误差界覆盖权重不是短二进制小数的网络。借助动态规划、模板检查、SMT 证明、广度优先搜索以及针对权重共享递归的归纳，该方法在所述定义域的所有输入上（最多 10^16 个输入，或规模界限内的每个图或网格）认证了 15 个写出网络中的 12 个（其中一个在单次常量修正后），每个耗时不超过一分钟 CPU。证书还指出网络在何处不再精确：最短路径网络当且仅当距离至多为 4,096 时精确，并在预测的跳数处失败。三十个新规范各由一个模型家族（Claude Opus 5.5）的全新会话编写。二十五个首次提交被认证为对任意求和顺序精确；五个税表在一次固定 float32 运行中，在每个整数美元处与真实税额的偏差保持在 $0.11 以内。一个开放的 27B 模型通过 30 个中的 23 个，在更多思考与代码执行下通过 25 个，因此该方法部分可迁移。我们还证明了从样例学习的两个局限：训练中从未激活的输入坐标无法通过更多范围内数据学到，且 Luhn 型校验和在其家族中具有指数级小的依赖目标的梯度方差。在相同架构上调优的梯度下降与两者一致，这两者涵盖我们五类失败中的两类。

items.title_en: When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents
items.title_zh: 当墨迹遇见像素：面向人工校正金融文档的VLM意图感知OCR
items.abstract_en: Human annotations on documents (such as arrows, carets, strikethroughs, and insertions) express corrective intent yet existing OCR and document understanding systems treat these marks as visual noise rather than semantic edit operations. We introduce intent-aware OCR, the task of generating corrected transcriptions by jointly reasoning over original document content and visual intent cues (handwritten or digital) that convey edit intent. To support this setting, we present DocIntent, a multimodal dataset of 1,600 financial documents with over 5,700 annotated visual intent cues, each paired with layout-aware, intent-resolved OCR targets. We further introduce IntentBench, a 216-document benchmark designed to evaluate model robustness under diverse real-world annotation conditions. Leveraging DocIntent, we fine-tune DocIntentOCR, a suite of 3B and 7B parameter vision-language models, under direct intent supervision on corrected transcriptions. On IntentBench, the fine-tuned 3B and 7B models achieve F1-scores of 0.81 and 0.83, respectively, substantially outperforming commercial closed-source (e.g., GPT-4.1 (0.626)), and open-source models (e.g., LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B (0.50)) demonstrating that intent-aware supervision enables compact domain-specific models to outperform substantially larger general-purpose systems on this task. This work establishes intent-aware OCR as a novel human-in-the-loop document understanding task and provides foundational resources (dataset, benchmark, models) to advance research in interactive document processing.
items.abstract_zh: 文档上的人工标注（如箭头、脱字符、删除线和插入内容）表达了校正意图，然而现有OCR与文档理解系统将这些标记视为视觉噪声，而非语义编辑操作。我们引入意图感知OCR，即通过联合推理原始文档内容与传达编辑意图的视觉意图线索（手写或数字）来生成校正后转录文本的任务。为支持这一设定，我们提出DocIntent，一个包含1,600份金融文档、超过5,700个标注视觉意图线索的多模态数据集，每个线索均配有布局感知且意图解析后的OCR目标。我们进一步引入IntentBench，一个包含216份文档的基准，旨在评估模型在多样真实标注条件下的鲁棒性。利用DocIntent，我们在校正转录文本上以直接意图监督微调DocIntentOCR，这是一套3B和7B参数的视觉-语言模型。在IntentBench上，微调后的3B和7B模型分别达到0.81和0.83的F1分数，显著优于商业闭源模型（如GPT-4.1（0.626））和开源模型（如LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B（0.50）），表明意图感知监督使紧凑的领域特定模型在该任务上能够优于规模大得多的通用系统。本工作将意图感知OCR确立为一种新的人在回路文档理解任务，并提供基础资源（数据集、基准、模型）以推进交互式文档处理研究。

items.title_en: FOCI: Trajectory Optimization on Gaussian Splats for Gaussian Robots
items.title_zh: FOCI：在高斯泼溅上为高斯机器人进行轨迹优化
items.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has recently gained popularity as a faster alternative to Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) in 3D reconstruction and view synthesis methods. Leveraging the spatial information encoded in 3DGS, this work proposes FOCI (Field Overlap Collision Integral), an algorithm that is able to optimize trajectories directly on the Gaussians themselves. FOCI leverages a novel and interpretable collision formulation for 3DGS using the notion of the overlap integral between Gaussians. The formulation presented applies to different robot morphologies (e.g., fixed and mobile base manipulators, legged robots, UAVs) and handles both static and dynamic Gaussian-Splat environments. Contrary to other approaches, which represent the robot with conservative bounding boxes that underestimate the traversability of the environment, we propose to represent the environment and the robot as Gaussian Splats. This not only has desirable computational properties, but also allows for orientation-aware planning, allowing the robot to pass through very tight and narrow spaces. We extensively test our algorithm in both synthetic and real Gaussian Splats, showcasing that collision-free trajectories for legged, aerial and manipulator robots can be computed in seconds, even with hundreds of thousands of Gaussians making up the environment. The code is available at https://github.com/leggedrobotics/foci
items.abstract_zh: 3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）近期作为神经辐射场（NeRF）的更快替代方案，在三维重建与视图合成方法中受到欢迎。利用3DGS中编码的空间信息，本文提出FOCI（场重叠碰撞积分），一种能够直接在高斯本身上优化轨迹的算法。FOCI利用高斯间重叠积分这一概念，为3DGS提出一种新颖且可解释的碰撞公式。所提出的公式适用于不同机器人形态（例如固定基座和移动基座机械臂、腿足机器人、无人机），并能处理静态和动态高斯泼溅环境。与其他用保守包围盒表示机器人从而低估环境可通行性的方法相反，我们提出将环境和机器人均表示为高斯泼溅。这不仅具有理想的计算性质，还允许朝向感知规划，使机器人能够通过非常狭小狭窄的空间。我们在合成和真实高斯泼溅中广泛测试该算法，展示即使环境中包含数十万个高斯，也能在数秒内计算出腿足、空中和机械臂机器人的无碰撞轨迹。代码见https://github.com/leggedrobotics/foci。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为用于视图合成的神经辐射场
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新颖视图方面取得了最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续5D坐标（空间位置 $(x,y,z)$ 和观察方向 $(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和视角相关发射辐射亮度。我们通过沿相机光线查询5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组具有已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何形状和外观的场景的逼真新视角，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Target-specifc machine-learning scoring functions boost structure-based virtual screening for PfDHODH
items.title_zh: 靶点特异性机器学习打分函数提升针对 PfDHODH 的基于结构的虚拟筛选
items.abstract_en: Plasmodium falciparum dihydroorotate dehydrogenase (PfDHODH) is a validated antimalarial target for which no inhibitor has yet been approved, and no target-specific machine learning scoring functions (ML SFs) have been reported for it. Here, we developed PfDHODH-specific ML SFs for structure-based virtual screening from a small dataset of 73 experimentally confirmed actives and 86 inactives, supplemented with property-matched (PM) and property-unmatched (PU) decoys. We compared five algorithms, several protein-ligand interaction featurisation schemes and classification and regression formulations under two evaluation designs: a Butina clustering split and a UMAP-based split in which each cluster of actives was held out in turn. The best model, a random forest regressor trained on PLEC fingerprints combined with Morgan fingerprints, was the strongest under both designs, reaching a normalised enrichment factor at 1% (NEF1%) of 0.617 on the Butina test set, compared with 0.323 for Smina, the best-performing generic SF, and an average NEF1% of 0.656 across the UMAP clusters (Smina: 0.362). Regression generally outperformed classification, and deep learning models were unstable with the limited training data. Adding PU decoys to the training set substantially improved enrichment for most held-out clusters, whereas the cluster most dissimilar to the training actives remained poorly predicted. These results show that target-specific ML SFs can be developed for a target with scarce bioactivity data, provided that algorithms, featurisation and evaluation design are tested comprehensively.
items.abstract_zh: 恶性疟原虫二氢乳清酸脱氢酶（PfDHODH）是一个经验证抗疟靶点，目前尚无抑制剂获批，也未见针对该靶点的特异性机器学习打分函数（ML SFs）报道。本文基于一个仅含73个实验确认活性物和86个非活性物的小型数据集，并补充性质匹配（PM）和性质不匹配（PU）诱饵，开发了用于基于结构虚拟筛选的 PfDHODH 特异性 ML SFs。我们在两种评估设计下比较了五种算法、多种蛋白-配体相互作用特征化方案以及分类和回归建模形式：Butina 聚类划分和基于 UMAP 的划分（其中每个活性物簇依次被留出）。最佳模型为在 PLEC 指纹与 Morgan 指纹组合上训练的随机森林回归器，在两种设计下均表现最强，在 Butina 测试集上达到1%归一化富集因子（NEF1%）0.617，而表现最好的通用打分函数 Smina 为0.323；在 UMAP 各簇上的平均 NEF1% 为0.656（Smina：0.362）。回归通常优于分类，而深度学习模型在有限训练数据下不稳定。向训练集加入 PU 诱饵可显著提高大多数留出簇的富集效果，但与训练活性物最不相似的那个簇仍预测较差。这些结果表明，只要全面测试算法、特征化和评估设计，即使靶点生物活性数据稀缺，也可开发靶点特异性 ML SFs。

items.title_en: High-Dimensional Single-Photon Frequency Conversion for Orbital Angular Momentum Comb State
items.title_zh: 高维单光子轨道角动量梳态的频率转换
items.abstract_en: The orbital angular momentum (OAM) degree of freedom provides an important resource for constructing high-dimensional optical quantum information systems. However, the generation of high-dimensional single-photon OAM comb state and its high-fidelity frequency conversion remain challenging due to limited spatial modulation resolution, imperfect mode matching, and finite nonlinear conversion efficiency. Here, we proposed and experimentally demonstrated a scalable scheme for the generation and frequency conversion of high-dimensional single-photon OAM comb state. We prepared a single-photon OAM comb state with a dimension of up to 128, achieving a fidelity of 0.787 between the reconstructed and target states and an effective dimension of 100. Furthermore, using the sum-frequency generation, we demonstrated the frequency upconversion of single-photon high-dimensional OAM comb state from the communication band to a visible wavelength of 520 nm, while verifying the preservation of both the OAM mode distribution and phase information through density matrix reconstruction. Our work established a versatile platform for the generation, manipulation, and characterization of high-dimensional OAM comb states, with potential applications in cross-band quantum information transfer, high-capacity quantum communication, and high-dimensional quantum networks.
items.abstract_zh: 轨道角动量（OAM）自由度为构建高维光学量子信息系统提供了重要资源。然而，由于空间调制分辨率有限、模式匹配不完美以及非线性转换效率有限，高维单光子OAM梳态的生成及其高保真频率转换仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出并实验演示了一种用于生成和频率转换高维单光子OAM梳态的可扩展方案。我们制备了维度高达128的单光子OAM梳态，在重建态与目标态之间实现了0.787的保真度，有效维度为100。此外，利用和频产生，我们演示了单光子高维OAM梳态从通信波段到520 nm可见波长的频率上转换，同时通过密度矩阵重建验证了OAM模式分布和相位信息均得以保留。我们的工作建立了一个用于高维OAM梳态生成、操纵和表征的多功能平台，在跨波段量子信息传输、大容量量子通信和高维量子网络方面具有潜在应用。

items.title_en: Do We Still Need Reinforcement Learning When We Can Read the World Model?
items.title_zh: 当我们可以读取世界模型时，还需要强化学习吗？
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has achieved remarkable success in sequential decision-making, but learning effective policies often requires substantial interaction experience. Model-based reinforcement learning alleviates this dependence by leveraging world models, which are typically used to support planning or policy optimization. In this paper, we investigate an alternative paradigm in which autonomous LLM-based coding agents directly synthesize control policies by reasoning over readable world models. By examining environment source code, these agents translate environmental knowledge into executable decision rules and iteratively refine their policies using online feedback or offline data, without task-specific RL training. Experiments across diverse decision-making benchmarks show that synthesized policies match or outperform conventional RL methods while requiring substantially less experience. Further analyses reveal interpretable decision rules and how they evolve through feedback-driven refinement. Comparisons with policies generated without source code access and experiments under challenging conditions further demonstrate the benefits of readable world models. These findings suggest that direct policy synthesis can reduce reliance on trial and error, challenging the necessity of task-specific RL training.
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习在序列决策中取得了显著成功，但学习有效策略通常需要大量交互经验。基于模型的强化学习通过利用世界模型缓解这种依赖，世界模型通常用于支持规划或策略优化。本文研究一种替代范式，其中基于LLM的自主编码智能体通过对可读世界模型进行推理，直接合成控制策略。通过检查环境源代码，这些智能体将环境知识转化为可执行决策规则，并使用在线反馈或离线数据迭代改进其策略，而无需任务特定的RL训练。跨多种决策基准的实验表明，合成策略在需要显著更少经验的同时，匹配或优于传统RL方法。进一步分析揭示了可解释的决策规则及其如何通过反馈驱动的改进而演化。与未访问源代码生成策略的比较以及在挑战性条件下的实验，进一步证明了可读世界模型的好处。这些发现表明，直接策略合成可以减少对试错的依赖，挑战了任务特定RL训练的必要性。

items.title_en: DRBench Pro: A Knowledge-Centric Benchmark for Professional Deep Research Agents
items.title_zh: DRBench Pro：面向专业深度研究智能体的以知识为中心的基准
items.abstract_en: Deep research agents gather information from multiple sources and synthesize it into reports on complex, open-ended questions. Existing benchmarks assess report quality along several dimensions, but lack a dedicated knowledge-centric evaluation of which research directions a report covers and how deeply it explores them. We introduce DRBench Pro, a benchmark that makes structured knowledge coverage the primary evaluation target. Our automated pipeline builds local knowledge trees from Wikipedia and uses sampled subgraphs to generate research queries and evidence-grounded rubrics. Each rubric corresponds to a relation in the tree, preserving the structure of the knowledge being evaluated. Agents receive only the research query. This structure allows us to measure breadth across major research directions and depth along related knowledge chains, with their geometric mean giving overall coverage. The benchmark includes 144 cases across 24 domains and 44,102 rubrics. Evaluating 16 deep research agents reveals different strengths in breadth and depth, with the best-performing agent reaching 57.04% overall coverage. Rubric judgments agree closely with human annotations, and agent rankings remain stable across the tested metric configurations.
items.abstract_zh: 深度研究智能体从多个来源收集信息，并将其综合成关于复杂、开放式问题的报告。现有基准从多个维度评估报告质量，但缺乏专门的以知识为中心的评估，即报告涵盖哪些研究方向以及对其探索的深度如何。我们推出DRBench Pro，一个将结构化知识覆盖作为主要评估目标的基准。我们的自动化流水线从Wikipedia构建局部知识树，并使用采样子图生成研究查询和基于证据的评分细则。每个评分细则对应于树中的一个关系，保留了被评估知识的结构。智能体仅接收研究查询。这种结构使我们能够测量跨主要研究方向的广度和沿相关知识链的深度，其几何平均值给出总体覆盖度。该基准包括跨越24个领域的144个案例和44,102条评分细则。评估16个深度研究智能体揭示了在广度和深度上的不同优势，表现最好的智能体达到57.04%的总体覆盖度。评分细则判断与人工标注高度一致，并且在测试的指标配置下智能体排名保持稳定。

items.title_en: AirLeg: A Robust and Accurate Self-Supervised Visual-Inertial-Leg SLAM System
items.title_zh: AirLeg：一种稳健且准确的自监督视觉-惯性-腿部SLAM系统
items.abstract_en: Visual-inertial-leg (VIL) state estimation offers cost-effective localization for legged robots, adding only a camera to the onboard IMU and joint encoders. However, learning-based leg odometry is limited by its supervision: networks trained in simulation suffer from the sim-to-real gap, while real-world labels require costly sensors or inherit the errors of visual estimates. To address this, we present AirLeg, a self-supervised VIL SLAM system in which vision and leg proprioception improve each other from training to deployment. We pre-train the leg odometry network in simulation and adapt it to the robot without ground truth through imperative learning, where multi-sensor bundle adjustment uses the leg odometry to refine the visual map, which in turn supervises the network. During deployment, the fused estimates adapt the network online. To improve both localization and this supervision, a dual-window estimator fuses vision, IMU, and leg odometry, relates loaded feet to the visually reconstructed terrain through a deformation-aware constraint, and weights the constraints by variance component estimation. AirLeg completes all 17 GrandTour sequences with the lowest average error (0.19 m) among 19 methods. On a low-cost quadruped, it achieves the lowest drift (0.6%) with only 0.5 h of unlabeled data, in real time on an embedded computer.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-惯性-腿部（VIL）状态估计为足式机器人提供了经济高效的定位，只需在机载IMU和关节编码器上添加一个相机。然而，基于学习的腿部里程计受限于其监督：在仿真中训练的网络遭受仿真到现实的差距，而真实世界标签需要昂贵的传感器或继承视觉估计的误差。为解决这一问题，我们提出AirLeg，一个自监督VIL SLAM系统，其中视觉和腿部本体感知从训练到部署相互改进。我们在仿真中预训练腿部里程计网络，并通过命令式学习在没有真值的情况下将其适配到机器人，其中多传感器束调整使用腿部里程计来细化视觉地图，而视觉地图反过来监督网络。在部署期间，融合估计在线调整网络。为了改进定位和这种监督，双窗口估计器融合视觉、IMU和腿部里程计，通过变形感知约束将受载足与视觉重建地形相关联，并通过方差分量估计对约束加权。AirLeg完成了全部17个GrandTour序列，在19种方法中具有最低的平均误差（0.19 m）。在低成本四足机器人上，它仅使用0.5小时未标注数据，在嵌入式计算机上实时实现了最低漂移（0.6%）。

items.title_en: WorldBridge: Bridging Scattered Views for Coherent 3D World Generation
items.title_zh: WorldBridge：桥接分散视图以实现连贯的三维世界生成
items.abstract_en: Generating coherent and explorable 3D worlds from scattered images with little or no visual overlap is a fundamental and long-standing challenge in computer vision, which existing geometry-aware methods fail to address. Meanwhile, existing image- and video-based methods may generate unseen regions but produce inconsistent geometry across views. To bridge this gap, we present WorldBridge, a framework for coherent and controllable 3D world generation under scattered images with little or no visual overlap. WorldBridge encodes scattered references into a global scene context to guide geometry and appearance generation across views. Our temporal and spatial reference attention mechanism further enhances the fidelity of temporal references along the target trajectory and supports flexible spatial references outside it. A plug-and-play latent-reference consistency strategy improves reference fidelity through reprojection-guided test-time optimization. We also introduce the WorldBridge benchmark suite to evaluate 3D world generation from scattered, low-overlap references, which is rarely explored by current benchmarks. Both qualitative and quantitative results demonstrate that our method enables controllable and coherent 3D world generation, surpassing the existing state-of-the-art solutions. Our project page is available at https://davidyan2001.github.io/WorldBridge/.
items.abstract_zh: 从视觉重叠很少或没有重叠的分散图像生成连贯且可探索的三维世界，是计算机视觉中一项基础且长期存在的挑战，现有几何感知方法无法解决。同时，现有的基于图像和视频的方法可能生成未观测区域，但会在不同视图间产生不一致的几何。为弥合这一差距，我们提出WorldBridge，一个用于在视觉重叠很少或没有重叠的分散图像下生成连贯且可控三维世界的框架。WorldBridge将分散参考编码为全局场景上下文，以指导跨视图的几何和外观生成。我们的时间与空间参考注意力机制进一步增强沿目标轨迹的时间参考保真度，并支持其外部的灵活空间参考。一种即插即用的潜在参考一致性策略通过重投影引导的测试时优化提高参考保真度。我们还引入WorldBridge基准套件，用于评估从分散、低重叠参考生成三维世界，这是当前基准很少探索的。定性和定量结果均表明，我们的方法能够实现可控且连贯的三维世界生成，超越现有最先进解决方案。项目页面见 https://davidyan2001.github.io/WorldBridge/。

items.title_en: Bayesian Learning of Spatially Heterogeneous Causal Structure in Spatial Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: 空间转录组学中空间异质因果结构的贝叶斯学习
items.abstract_en: Spatial transcriptomics preserves the location of each expression profile, making it possible to study how gene regulatory networks differ within a tissue. Across regions of a tissue, regulatory relationships may vary and even reverse direction, so identifying the causal relationships in a specific pathological region can provide insight into therapeutic targets. We propose SpaDAG, a Bayesian method for learning spatially varying causal directed acyclic graphs. By defining the graphs on a triangulation of the tissue, SpaDAG allows each edge to have its own spatial pattern and even to reverse direction across regions. We show that the graphs nonetheless remain fully identifiable, and develop an MCMC sampler that explores them efficiently by reversing an edge over an entire connected region in a single move. SpaDAG outperforms competing methods in simulations with and without direction reversals. In a section spanning a renal cell carcinoma and the adjacent kidney, SpaDAG finds largely different relationships in the two tissues, with those in the tumor concentrated on genes associated with therapeutic targets. Between two of these genes, it identifies a relationship whose direction reverses across the tumor boundary, generating hypotheses about their region-specific coupling. Supplementary materials and code for this article are available online.
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学保留每个表达谱的位置，使得研究基因调控网络如何在组织内不同区域存在差异成为可能。在组织的不同区域，调控关系可能变化甚至方向反转，因此识别特定病理区域中的因果关系可为治疗靶点提供洞见。我们提出SpaDAG，一种学习空间变化因果有向无环图的贝叶斯方法。通过在组织的三角剖分上定义图，SpaDAG允许每条边具有自己的空间模式，甚至在不同区域间反转方向。我们证明这些图仍然完全可识别，并开发了一种MCMC采样器，通过在单次移动中反转整个连通区域上的一条边来高效探索这些图。在有方向反转和无方向反转的模拟中，SpaDAG均优于竞争方法。在跨越肾细胞癌及邻近肾脏的切片中，SpaDAG发现两种组织中的关系存在很大差异，肿瘤中的关系集中于与治疗靶点相关的基因。在其中两个基因之间，它识别出一种在肿瘤边界两侧方向反转的关系，从而生成关于其区域特异性耦合的假设。本文的补充材料和代码可在线获取。

items.title_en: Deep-learning-enabled rapid spatially multiplexed wavefront sensing with a thin diffuser
items.title_zh: 深度学习赋能的薄扩散器快速空间复用波前传感
items.abstract_en: Conventional wavefront sensing typically measures aberrations along a single guide-star direction, limiting the correction of field-dependent aberrations over a wide field of view. Spatial multiplexing with a thin diffuser enables simultaneous measurements across multiple isoplanatic patches, but the computational cost of reconstruction makes it difficult to track changing aberrations. We propose a deep-learning approach that combines recurrent all-pairs field transforms for displacement estimation with Zernike coefficient regression. Experimental results show that the method accurately reconstructs multiple wavefronts from a single speckle pattern and reduces three-channel reconstruction time from 2801.6 ms with conventional digital image correlation (DIC) to 23.1 ms. The reconstructed wavefronts agreed more closely with sequential single-channel references than those obtained by multiplexed DIC, and simulations showed that Zernike regression was more robust to noise than direct gradient integration. These results suggest a path toward dynamic wide-field aberration sensing and high-speed adaptive optics.
items.abstract_zh: 传统波前传感通常沿单一导星方向测量像差，限制了宽视场内场相关像差的校正。使用薄扩散器的空间复用能够跨多个等晕区分块同时测量，但重建的计算成本使跟踪变化的像差变得困难。我们提出一种深度学习方法，将用于位移估计的循环全对场变换与Zernike系数回归相结合。实验结果表明，该方法能够从单幅散斑图案准确重建多个波前，并将三通道重建时间从传统数字图像相关（DIC）的2801.6 ms降低到23.1 ms。与多路复用DIC相比，重建波前与顺序单通道参考更接近，仿真表明Zernike回归比直接梯度积分对噪声更稳健。这些结果指向动态宽场像差传感和高速自适应光学的一条路径。

items.title_en: A Real-Time Low-Cost Platform for Non-Contact Respiratory Rate Monitoring: A Comparative Evaluation of RGB Optical Flow and Time-of-Flight Depth Sensing
items.title_zh: 用于非接触式呼吸率监测的实时低成本平台：RGB光流与飞行时间深度传感的比较评估
items.abstract_en: Respiratory rate (RR) is one of the earliest indicators of clinical deterioration, which makes its continuous measurement clinically valuable. In routine practice, however, RR is monitored almost exclusively with contact-based sensors, which require skin attachment, may alter natural breathing, and are poorly tolerated by vulnerable groups such as newborns and elderly patients. Non-contact sensing removes these constraints, with RGB video and depth imaging among its most accessible modalities. In this work, we present a low-cost, real-time platform based on a single multimodal sensor that provides both RGB and time-of-flight (ToF) data streams, implemented on a Raspberry Pi 5 edge device. The system integrates three RGB optical-flow pipelines, namely Farnebäck, Horn--Schunck, and Lucas--Kanade, together with a depth-based pipeline incorporating region-of-interest stabilization and distance-derived signal extraction, enabling the two modalities to be evaluated independently under the same experimental protocol. The proposed approach was evaluated on twelve healthy volunteers following a controlled protocol, including normal breathing, hyperventilation, and breath-holding, using a piezoresistive respiratory belt as a reference. RGB-based methods achieved lower RR estimation errors, with Lucas--Kanade attaining the lowest median MAE (3.83 BPM), whereas the ToF-based pipeline, although less accurate for RR estimation (median MAE 6.24 BPM), reached a higher apnea detection sensitivity (0.66 vs 0.51-0.55). These findings highlight the complementary strengths of both modalities and support their integration into unified low-cost platforms.
items.abstract_zh: 呼吸率（RR）是临床恶化最早的指标之一，这使得其连续测量具有临床价值。然而，在常规实践中，RR几乎完全使用接触式传感器监测，这些传感器需要皮肤附着，可能改变自然呼吸，并且新生儿和老年患者等脆弱群体耐受性较差。非接触式传感消除了这些限制，其中RGB视频和深度成像是最易获取的模态之一。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个基于单个多模态传感器的低成本实时平台，该传感器提供RGB和飞行时间（ToF）数据流，并在Raspberry Pi 5边缘设备上实现。该系统集成了三种RGB光流流水线，即Farnebäck、Horn--Schunck和Lucas--Kanade，以及一个基于深度的流水线，该流水线结合了感兴趣区域稳定和距离导出信号提取，使得两种模态能够在相同实验协议下独立评估。所提出的方法在12名健康志愿者上按照受控协议进行评估，包括正常呼吸、过度通气和屏气，并使用压阻式呼吸带作为参考。基于RGB的方法实现了更低的RR估计误差，其中Lucas--Kanade达到最低的中位MAE（3.83 BPM），而基于ToF的流水线虽然在RR估计上准确性较低（中位MAE 6.24 BPM），但达到了更高的呼吸暂停检测灵敏度（0.66 vs 0.51-0.55）。这些发现突显了两种模态的互补优势，并支持将它们集成到统一的低成本平台中。

items.title_en: Stable Gated DeltaNet-2: Understanding and Mitigating Recurrent State Instability
items.title_zh: 稳定的门控DeltaNet-2：理解并缓解循环状态不稳定性
items.abstract_en: Linear attention offers an efficient solution for long-sequence modeling via linear complexity and fixed-size recurrent states. Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) introduces independent channel-wise control over erasure and writing, enhancing state-update expressiveness and in-context retrieval, yet it suffers from training failures during long-context training. We trace these failures to the asymmetry between reading and modification directions during erasure, which yields non-normal erase operators whose directional gains accumulate across tokens, triggering exponential state growth even without new writes. To resolve this, we propose \model{}, employing symmetric erasure to ensure non-expansive state propagation and decay-regulated residual writing to preserve writing flexibility. Theoretically, we establish an $O(\sqrt{T})$ upper bound on recurrent state growth while retaining chunkwise parallel computation. Experiments on ~1.6B parameter models show that \model{} achieves stable training alongside improved long-context retrieval. Compared to GDN-2, it boosts the 128K average RULER score by 6.80 points in the recurrent setting and average accuracy across nine downstream tasks by 0.62 points in the hybrid setting.
items.abstract_zh: 线性注意力通过线性复杂度和固定大小循环状态，为长序列建模提供了高效解决方案。门控DeltaNet-2（GDN-2）引入对擦除和写入的独立逐通道控制，增强了状态更新的表达能力与上下文检索，但它在长上下文训练期间会出现训练失败。我们将这些失败追溯到擦除期间读取与修改方向之间的不对称性，这会产生非正规擦除算子，其方向增益跨token累积，即使没有新的写入也会触发指数级状态增长。为解决此问题，我们提出\model{}，采用对称擦除以确保非扩张状态传播，并采用衰减调节的残差写入以保持写入灵活性。理论上，我们在保留分块并行计算的同时，建立了循环状态增长的$O(\sqrt{T})$上界。在约1.6B参数模型上的实验表明，\model{}在实现稳定训练的同时改进了长上下文检索。与GDN-2相比，它在循环设置中将128K平均RULER分数提高6.80分，在混合设置中将九个下游任务的平均准确率提高0.62分。

items.title_en: RePace: Reasoning about Demonstration Speedup for Faster Vision-Language-Action Policies
items.title_zh: RePace：推理示教加速以实现更快的视觉-语言-动作策略
items.abstract_en: Since vision-language-action (VLA) policies can inherit the slow pace of human demonstrations, accelerating these demonstrations before fine-tuning can lead to faster VLA policies without an additional speed-selection module at deployment. Several offline speedup methods have focused on identifying segments that require less precision and assigning predefined speedup factors to the segments. However, even within a single segment, a speedup factor suitable for steady motion may be too high when precise alignment is required. To this end, this paper presents RePace, an offline reasoning framework that determines how much to accelerate each part of a demonstration. For the same recorded movement, RePace measures how much each candidate speedup factor shortens the sequence and compares the resulting observation-action pairs used for training. Given the task instruction, a pretrained language model uses the visual context and original motion of successive windows to interpret these candidate retiming effects and select a speedup profile for the complete episode. Experimental results demonstrate that RePace outperforms the baselines in overall task execution efficiency on both LIBERO and RoboCasa-Kitchen. On all three tasks with a gripper-equipped Franka Research 3 arm, RePace matches or exceeds the acceleration baselines in success rate and completes successful trials faster.
items.abstract_zh: 由于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略可能继承人类示教的缓慢节奏，在微调之前加速这些示教可以在部署时无需额外速度选择模块的情况下得到更快的VLA策略。若干离线加速方法侧重于识别需要较少精度的片段，并为这些片段分配预定义加速因子。然而，即使在单个片段内，适合稳定运动的加速因子在需要精确对齐时也可能过高。为此，本文提出RePace，一个离线推理框架，用于确定对示教各部分加速多少。对于同一记录运动，RePace衡量每个候选加速因子将序列缩短多少，并比较用于训练所得的观察-动作对。给定任务指令，预训练语言模型利用连续窗口的视觉上下文和原始运动来解释这些候选重定时效果，并为完整回合选择加速配置。实验结果表明，RePace在LIBERO和RoboCasa-Kitchen上的整体任务执行效率均优于基线。在配备夹爪的Franka Research 3机械臂上的全部三个任务中，RePace在成功率上匹配或超过加速基线，并更快完成成功试验。

items.title_en: Beyond Feature Fusion: Sensor-Grounded Semantic-Spiking Learning for Robust Object Detection
items.title_zh: 超越特征融合：基于传感器的语义脉冲学习用于鲁棒目标检测
items.abstract_en: Underexposure weakens object details, and overexposure obscures boundaries. Spike cameras encode light into high-frequency binary streams. Long-window spike counts give stable appearance cues, while short observations reveal changes in firing rates from sparse measurements. We propose SPIRE, a sensor-grounded semantic-spiking framework for illumination-robust object detection from a single spike stream. SPIRE builds an appearance view from the full packet through detection-oriented illumination adaptation and constructs a sequence of cumulative views from progressively longer prefixes. Each prefix supplies a rate map, an edge map, and a rate difference that tracks changes as spikes accumulate. At selected scales, ANN features and spike-derived initialization jointly set the initial membrane potentials and firing thresholds, allowing semantic cues to shape the responses during temporal encoding. Local spike-count contrasts supervise both branches during training. The residual between measured and ANN-predicted contrasts combines with the spiking features to produce a bounded correction to the fused feature pyramid. On simulated VOC and COCO, SPIRE-D outperforms the strongest baseline by 4.00-5.50 AP50 points across the four under- and overexposure settings. On real PKU-Vidar-DVS recordings, it achieves 67.07 AP50 and 40.10 AP75. SPIRE-D also uses 50.4% fewer MACs than SPFD.
items.abstract_zh: 欠曝光会削弱物体细节，过曝光会模糊边界。脉冲相机将光编码为高频二值流。长窗口脉冲计数提供稳定的外观线索，而短时观测从稀疏测量中揭示发放率的变化。我们提出 SPIRE，一种基于传感器的语义脉冲框架，用于从单条脉冲流进行光照鲁棒的目标检测。SPIRE 通过面向检测的光照自适应从完整数据包构建外观视图，并从逐渐增长的前缀构建一系列累积视图。每个前缀提供速率图、边缘图以及随脉冲累积跟踪变化的速率差。在选定尺度上，ANN 特征和脉冲派生初始化共同设置初始膜电位和发放阈值，使语义线索在时间编码期间塑造响应。局部脉冲计数对比在训练期间监督两个分支。测量对比度与 ANN 预测对比度之间的残差与脉冲特征结合，对融合特征金字塔产生有界校正。在模拟 VOC 和 COCO 上，SPIRE-D 在四种欠曝光和过曝光设置下以 4.00–5.50 AP50 点优于最强基线。在真实 PKU-Vidar-DVS 记录上，达到 67.07 AP50 和 40.10 AP75。SPIRE-D 的 MACs 也比 SPFD 少 50.4%。

items.title_en: Cell and nuclear shapes predict confined motility
items.title_zh: 细胞和细胞核形状预测受限运动
items.abstract_en: Cancer metastasis relies on an enhanced property of cells to migrate efficiently even through constrictions smaller than their nucleus. Both cell and nuclear morphology may influence this process. How these morphologies relate to the likelihood that a cell will transit through a constriction remains unclear. Here we combine microfluidic experiments with machine learning to predict whether MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells are able to transit through narrow constrictions. Cells migrate within vertically confined boxes, and may migrate into neighboring boxes by transiting through constrictions, requiring a deformation of the nucleus. Defining a set of 12 geometrical features derived from cell and nuclear contours, we find that their average values are not statistically indicative of whether or not a cell will transit. To overcome this limitation, we use trajectories to train classifiers and evaluate their ability to predict future transit events. We find that the cell area and cell circularity carry most of the predictive information and less circular cells are more likely to transit. Without retraining, the models also predict transit through narrower constrictions and in more adhesive substrates. Morphological features of cells about 30 minutes before a transit event proved most informative about future transit events occurring or not. Together, our results show that cell shape, readable from simple contour descriptors, contains a transferable but condition-dependent signature of imminent transit.
items.abstract_zh: 癌症转移依赖于细胞的一种增强特性，即即使穿过小于其细胞核的狭窄收缩处也能高效迁移。细胞和细胞核的形态都可能影响这一过程。这些形态与细胞通过收缩处的可能性之间的关系仍不清楚。在这里，我们将微流控实验与机器学习相结合，以预测 MDA-MB-231 乳腺癌细胞是否能够通过狭窄收缩处。细胞在垂直受限的盒子内迁移，并可能通过穿过收缩处迁移到相邻盒子中，这需要细胞核发生变形。我们定义了由细胞和细胞核轮廓导出的 12 个几何特征，发现它们的平均值在统计上并不能指示细胞是否会通过。为克服这一限制，我们使用轨迹训练分类器，并评估其预测未来通过事件的能力。我们发现细胞面积和细胞圆度承载了大部分预测信息，且圆度较低的细胞更可能通过。无需重新训练，这些模型还能预测通过更窄收缩处以及在更具黏附性的基底上的通过情况。通过事件前约 30 分钟的细胞形态特征对未来是否发生通过事件最具信息量。总之，我们的结果表明，可从简单轮廓描述符读取的细胞形状包含一种可迁移但依赖条件的即将通过特征。

items.title_en: Packing the Bragg sphere: complete three-dimensional photonic band gaps at the refractive index of polymers (1.55)
items.title_zh: 填充布拉格球：在聚合物折射率（1.55）下实现完整三维光子带隙
items.abstract_en: Complete 3D photonic band gaps have so far been found only at refractive-index contrasts of about 1.9 and above, reached by rod-connected diamond lattice structures. Reciprocal-space design of quasiperiodic structures recently achieved considerable emission attenuation at much lower contrasts [L. Maiwald et al., Adv. Optical Mater. 10, 2100785 (2022)]. Here we implement systematic search and reciprocal-space design of periodic 3D structures with complete band gaps, solving a discrete optimization problem on an integer lattice. A gap above a high band needs the strongest Fourier components of the dielectric close to the Bragg sphere of that band. Crystals with large cells, started from Fourier peaks at the vertices of a polyhedron on this sphere and optimized against densely refined band edges, open complete gaps down to an index contrast of 1.55, that of common polymers against air. A rational approximant of an icosidodecahedron gave the most efficient location of the Fourier peaks among the polyhedra tested. Numerical calculations confirm the gaps over a resolution series, with band edges searched over the whole Brillouin zone. The best designs are connected porous networks, suited to a microwave test with printed polymer. A rigorous bound, valid for any structure, does not exclude gaps at lower index, and the next rational approximants of the icosidodecahedron, whose Bragg zones match bands 576 and 2440 almost exactly, point to where gaps at even lower contrast may be sought.
items.abstract_zh: 迄今为止，完整三维光子带隙仅在约 1.9 及以上的折射率对比度下被发现，由杆连接金刚石晶格结构实现。准周期结构的倒空间设计最近在低得多的对比度下实现了显著的发射衰减 [L. Maiwald 等，Adv. Optical Mater. 10, 2100785 (2022)]。本文实施对具有完整带隙的周期性三维结构的系统搜索与倒空间设计，在整数格点上求解离散优化问题。高能带之上的带隙需要介电常数的最强傅里叶分量靠近该能带的布拉格球。大晶胞晶体从该球面上多面体顶点处的傅里叶峰出发，并针对密集细化的带边进行优化，可将完整带隙打开到折射率对比度低至 1.55，即常见聚合物相对于空气的对比度。在测试的多面体中，二十面十二面体（icosidodecahedron）的有理近似给出了傅里叶峰的最有效位置。数值计算在一系列分辨率上确认了带隙，并在整个布里渊区搜索带边。最佳设计是连通多孔网络，适合用印刷聚合物进行微波测试。一个对任何结构均成立的严格界并不排除更低折射率下的带隙；二十面十二面体的后续有理近似（其布拉格区几乎精确匹配第 576 和第 2440 能带）指出了可在何处寻找更低对比度下的带隙。

items.title_en: Decoupling the clocks of learning and computing in spiking neural networks
items.title_zh: 解耦脉冲神经网络中学习与计算的时钟
items.abstract_en: Biological intelligence thrives on minimal power despite its noisy, imperfect components, with neurons that communicate through voltage spikes. Brain-inspired computing seeks to bring such efficiency to real devices, which requires training methods tailored to them. The standard way to train spiking neural networks, backpropagation through time, computes weight updates through every step of a simulated device, so faithful or long simulations can make training costly and unstable. Here we show that spiking networks can learn reliably and efficiently by decoupling the clock of learning from that of computing. Our method, ChronoProp, calculates weight updates from each neuron's spike counts in fixed time bins using its measured input-output function. Compared with backpropagation through time, ChronoProp reaches similar accuracy in image classification, with about 3 times less training time and 20 times less memory at the finest timestep tested, and up to 10 times fewer spikes. On spoken-word benchmarks, ChronoProp is far more accurate in recurrent networks at fine timesteps, and with simple, hardware-compatible techniques it approaches the best published models. These networks also tolerate simulated hardware defects and limitations better than those trained with backpropagation through time. Therefore, ChronoProp enables stable and efficient training in simulations close to the continuous time of analog hardware.
items.abstract_zh: 生物智能尽管其组件嘈杂且不完美，仍以极低功耗蓬勃发展，其神经元通过电压脉冲进行通信。类脑计算力图将这种效率带入真实设备，这需要为其量身定制的训练方法。训练脉冲神经网络的标准方法——随时间反向传播——通过模拟设备的每一步计算权重更新，因此保真或长时间的模拟会使训练成本高昂且不稳定。本文表明，通过将学习时钟与计算时钟解耦，脉冲网络可以可靠且高效地学习。我们的方法 ChronoProp 利用每个神经元测得的输入-输出函数，根据其在固定时间 bin 内的脉冲计数计算权重更新。与随时间反向传播相比，ChronoProp 在图像分类中达到相似精度，在测试的最细时间步下训练时间约少 3 倍、内存约少 20 倍，脉冲数最多少 10 倍。在口语词基准上，ChronoProp 在细时间步的循环网络中准确得多，并且借助简单、硬件兼容的技术，它接近已发表的最佳模型。这些网络对模拟硬件缺陷和限制的容忍度也优于使用随时间反向传播训练的网络。因此，ChronoProp 能够在接近模拟硬件连续时间的仿真中实现稳定高效的训练。
