items.title_en: Repairing the Trustworthiness of Distilled Language Models
items.title_zh: 修复蒸馏语言模型的可信性
items.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation enables the deployment of large language models through smaller student models, but the compression process can introduce regressions in trustworthiness even when downstream performance is preserved. Repairing such failures is challenging because the original distillation corpus is often unavailable, while direct preference optimization may alter capabilities inherited from the teacher. We propose a targeted repair framework based on the proximal Bregman response function (PBRF) that addresses both limitations. We estimate the curvature required for PBRF using a surrogate proxy dataset, removing dependence on the original transfer corpus, and extend the framework to preference-based supervision through an odds-ratio objective. This enables the use of preferred and dispreferred response pairs while constraining changes to the distilled model. Our results show that the proposed approach improves targeted trustworthiness behaviors for both pre-training and post-training models while largely preserving downstream performance, providing a practical alternative to re-distillation or unconstrained preference optimization. Our experiment results show that across different distilled models, the trustworthy regression can be improved by up to 8% with less than 1% decrement in perplexity.
items.abstract_zh: 知识蒸馏通过较小的学生模型实现大语言模型的部署，但压缩过程即使在保持下游性能时也可能引入可信性退化。修复此类失败具有挑战性，因为原始蒸馏语料通常不可用，而直接偏好优化可能改变从教师模型继承的能力。我们提出一种基于近端 Bregman 响应函数（PBRF）的目标修复框架，可解决这两个限制。我们使用替代代理数据集估计 PBRF 所需的曲率，从而消除对原始迁移语料的依赖；并通过优势比目标将框架扩展到基于偏好的监督。这使得可以使用偏好和非偏好响应对，同时约束对蒸馏模型的改变。结果表明，所提方法改善了预训练和后训练模型的目标可信性行为，同时基本保持下游性能，为重新蒸馏或无约束偏好优化提供了一种实用替代方案。实验结果表明，在不同蒸馏模型上，可信性退化最多可改善 8%，而困惑度下降小于 1%。

items.title_en: MERLoc: Robust Robot Localization in Dynamic Environments with Pose-Based Retrieval over 3D Gaussian Splatting References
items.title_zh: MERLoc：动态环境中基于姿态检索 3D 高斯泼溅参考的鲁棒机器人定位
items.abstract_en: Robots operating in previously mapped spaces must localize accurately despite moving people and rearranged objects. Most localization pipelines match the query against a sparse set of captured reference images retrieved by appearance, which is brittle under scene change and repeating structures. We present MERLoc, which turns a single metric 3D Gaussian Splatting scan into a dense Functional Reference Memory. Reference views are sampled over the navigable space for the robot's morphology and sensors at a target density and rendered offline. Pre-encoding them for the chosen off-the-shelf localizer removes the reference encoder from inference. A pose-based retrieval strategy then selects references by spatial proximity and viewing direction rather than appearance, sidestepping visual ambiguities whenever a prior exists. Across one classical and four learned localizers in simulated and real dynamic scenes, pose-based retrieval matches or outperforms appearance retrieval in most cases, even when the latter is gated by the same prior. On real data, it lowers position RMSE by 15-60 % in nine of ten backend/split combinations, and the rendered memory outperforms real-image caches posed by Structure-from-Motion. The system runs onboard a Jetson Orin NX at 5 Hz, enabling a navigation policy to successfully traverse a hallway with people roaming and rearranging objects.
items.abstract_zh: 在先前建图空间中运行的机器人必须在有人移动和物体被重新布置的情况下仍准确地位。大多数定位流水线将查询与通过外观检索到的一组稀疏采集参考图像进行匹配，这在场景变化和重复结构下较为脆弱。我们提出 MERLoc，它将单个度量 3D 高斯泼溅扫描转化为稠密功能参考记忆。参考视图根据机器人的形态和传感器在可导航空间上以目标密度采样，并离线渲染。为所选现成定位器预编码这些视图，从而在推理中移除参考编码器。随后，基于姿态的检索策略按空间邻近度和观察方向而非外观选择参考，从而在存在先验时避开视觉歧义。在仿真和真实动态场景中，针对一个经典和四个学习型定位器，基于姿态的检索在大多数情况下匹配或优于外观检索，即使后者由相同先验门控。在真实数据上，它在十个后端/划分组合中的九个将位置 RMSE 降低 15–60%，并且渲染记忆优于由运动恢复结构（Structure-from-Motion）位姿化的真实图像缓存。该系统在 Jetson Orin NX 上以 5 Hz 机载运行，使导航策略能够成功穿过有人走动并重新布置物体的走廊。

items.title_en: AnyCam: Anything Can Represent Camera for Video Generation
items.title_zh: AnyCam：任何物体均可作为相机表示用于视频生成
items.abstract_en: Camera-controlled video generation re-renders a video along a target camera trajectory, yet moving the camera around an object, the most natural way to change the viewpoint of an object-centric scene, remains difficult. Existing methods condition either on camera parameters, which are scale-ambiguous in monocular video, or on explicit geometry such as warped point clouds or depth, which breaks down under large viewpoint changes. We present AnyCam, a method that represents the camera with an anchor object in the scene: we reconstruct it in 3D and render it along the target trajectory, a camera signal that is scale-aware, view-complete and easy to specify relative to the object. A video diffusion model transfers the content and dynamics of the source video to the new viewpoint. Its H-Concat layout aligns source and target frames in time, so the model can be distilled into AnyCam-AR, a streaming few-step generator for on-the-fly camera control. Both models are trained on paired videos with pixel-aligned anchor renderings from multi-camera videos and static-scene captures. Experiments on diverse datasets and trajectories show that AnyCam performs favorably against camera-controlled video generation and 3D reconstruction methods in camera control and visual quality.
items.abstract_zh: 相机控制的视频生成沿目标相机轨迹重新渲染视频，但围绕物体移动相机——改变以物体为中心场景视角的最自然方式——仍然困难。现有方法要么以相机参数为条件（在单目视频中尺度歧义），要么以显式几何（如变形点云或深度）为条件，而后者在大视角变化下失效。我们提出 AnyCam，一种用场景中的锚定物体表示相机的方法：我们在 3D 中重建该物体并沿目标轨迹渲染它，这是一种尺度感知、视角完整且易于相对于物体指定的相机信号。视频扩散模型将源视频的内容和动态迁移到新视角。其 H-Concat 布局在时间上对齐源帧和目标帧，因此模型可以蒸馏为 AnyCam-AR，一个用于即时相机控制的流式少步生成器。两个模型均在配对视频上训练，这些视频带有来自多相机视频和静态场景采集的像素对齐锚定物渲染。在不同数据集和轨迹上的实验表明，AnyCam 在相机控制和视觉质量方面优于相机控制的视频生成与 3D 重建方法。

items.title_en: Benchmarking Protein Structure Tokenizers as Generation Targets for Language Models
items.title_zh: 将蛋白质结构分词器作为语言模型生成目标的基准测试
items.abstract_en: Discrete structure tokenizers are the standard way to give a language model access to protein three-dimensional structure, yet they are selected on how accurately they can be read, their reconstruction fidelity, while the property that governs generation is how well a model can write them. We measure this property, writability, directly: holding the base model, data, recipe and compute fixed, we swap only the tokenizer and train the same 9B model to emit structure tokens residue by residue, over eight tokenizers, four compute budgets and three evaluation sets (96 cells). At 2B tokens final writability runs from TM 0.662 down to 0.378 under identical conditions, with five of the eight arms clearing the TM 0.5 mark at which a fold is usually called correct and three falling short of it. Neither codebook size nor reconstruction ceiling explains where an arm lands; the best and worst both use 8192 codewords. What does explain the spread is local structure preservation of the code space. In DPLM-2 a one-bit codeword error costs 0.019 TM where a random codeword costs 0.347, and the trained model's own errors are correspondingly local, at 0.51 of the random Hamming expectation; FoldToken4 fails both tests at the same codebook size and is 0.13 TM less writable. Three controls discipline how such a benchmark may be read. A same-recipe rerun puts the noise floor at $σ=0.0067$ TM, which collapses an apparent six-way ranking into four tiers. A reference-free geometry panel turns out to be nearly orthogonal to TM (Pearson $-0.58$), with the worst arm by TM producing the most physically valid backbones. And two pre-registered interventions are null for a reason the mechanism measurements reveal: the quantity they target saturates at 1.5B tokens while TM is still rising. All 131 evaluation cells, including raw generated token streams, are released.
items.abstract_zh: 离散结构分词器是让语言模型获取蛋白质三维结构的标准方式，但它们是根据可被读取的准确程度（即重建保真度）来选择的，而支配生成的属性是模型能多好地写出这些分词。我们直接测量这一属性——可写性：固定基础模型、数据、训练配方和算力，仅替换分词器，训练同一个 9B 模型逐个残基地输出结构分词，覆盖 8 个分词器、4 个算力预算和 3 个评估集（96 个单元）。在 2B token 时，相同条件下最终可写性从 TM 0.662 降至 0.378，八个实验组中有五个超过通常将折叠判为正确的 TM 0.5 阈值，三个未达到。码本大小和重建上限都不能解释实验组所处的位置；最好和最差的实验组都使用 8192 个码字。解释这种差异的是码空间的局部结构保持。在 DPLM-2 中，一位码字错误造成 0.019 TM 的损失，而随机码字造成 0.347 的损失，训练模型自身的错误也相应是局部的，为随机汉明期望的 0.51；FoldToken4 在相同码本大小下两项测试均未通过，并且可写性低 0.13 TM。三项对照约束了应如何解读这样的基准。同配方重跑将噪声底设为 σ=0.0067 TM，这使表面上六路排名压缩为四个层级。一个无参考几何评估面板结果与 TM 几乎正交（Pearson -0.58），按 TM 最差的实验组反而产生物理上最有效的骨架。两项预注册干预均为零效应，机制测量揭示了原因：它们所针对的量在 1.5B token 时饱和，而 TM 仍在上升。所有 131 个评估单元，包括原始生成的分词流，均已发布。

items.title_en: Dynamic tuning of anisotropy-induced quasi-bound-states-in-the-continuum in liquid-crystal integrated dielectric metasurfaces
items.title_zh: 液晶集成介质超表面中各向异性诱导的连续域准束缚态的动态调谐
items.abstract_en: Symmetry-protected quasi-bound states in the continuum (qBICs) in all-dielectric metasurfaces can be excited either by introducing a geometrical asymmetry into the unit cell or by illuminating the metasurface under oblique incidence. To date, tuning the coupling strength of such qBICs to the continuum has mainly relied on control of the geometrical asymmetry. Here, we show that qBICs can also be induced in a symmetric dielectric metasurface by embedding the latter into an anisotropic birefringent medium, and that they can be actively tuned by either rotating the anisotropy axis of the medium or by varying the degree of anisotropy. We experimentally implement a corresponding system by embedding a highly symmetric silicon nanocylinder metasurface into a nematic liquid crystal (LC) cell. Importantly, the LC does not only provide the desired birefringence, but also dynamic control of its strength as well as of the orientation of its anisotropy axis in response to different external stimuli. Specifically, applying voltage across the LC cell, where the LC molecules are pre-aligned along one of the lattice directions of the metasurface, enables out-of-plane rotation of the anisotropy axis of the LC medium. Meanwhile, its birefringence can be tuned by changing the temperature. In our experiments, the coupling of the qBICs to the radiation continuum is first maximized by the application of 25 V across the LC cell at room temperature. We then systematically tune the temperature and show that the resonance depth of the qBIC modes, which is associated with their coupling strength to the continuum, of the qBIC modes increases monotonously with birefringence. Our findings establish anisotropy-induced qBICs in LC integrated dielectric metasurfaces as a promising platform for actively reconfigurable metasurfaces and their applications in displays, optical modulation and tunable photonic devices.
items.abstract_zh: 全介质超表面中的对称保护连续域准束缚态（qBIC）可通过在单元胞中引入几何不对称性或斜入射照射超表面来激发。迄今为止，调节此类 qBIC 与连续域的耦合强度主要依赖于控制几何不对称性。在此，我们表明，通过将对称介质超表面嵌入各向异性双折射介质中，也可诱导 qBIC，并且可通过旋转介质各向异性轴或改变各向异性程度对其进行主动调谐。我们通过将高度对称的硅纳米圆柱超表面嵌入向列相液晶（LC）盒中，实验实现了相应系统。重要的是，LC 不仅提供所需双折射，还能响应不同外部刺激动态控制其强度以及各向异性轴取向。具体而言，在 LC 分子沿超表面一个晶格方向预排列的 LC 盒上施加电压，可实现 LC 介质各向异性轴的面外旋转。同时，其双折射可通过改变温度进行调谐。在我们的实验中，首先通过在室温下于 LC 盒上施加 25 V 电压，使 qBIC 与辐射连续域的耦合最大化。然后我们系统调谐温度，并表明 qBIC 模式的共振深度随双折射单调增加，该深度与其和连续域的耦合强度相关。我们的发现确立了液晶集成介质超表面中各向异性诱导的 qBIC 作为主动可重构超表面及其在显示器、光调制和可调谐光子器件中应用的有前景平台。

items.title_en: Interpretable identification of constitutive parameter field for three-dimensional heterogeneous and graded hyperelastic materials from full-field displacements
items.title_zh: 从全场位移对三维非均质与梯度超弹性材料本构参数场进行可解释识别
items.abstract_en: The inverse problem of identifying spatially varying material properties of heterogeneous solids using experimentally available displacement fields and boundary reaction forces alone remains challenging. Being able to characterize heterogeneous and graded solids would be advantageous in the design and manufacturing of functionally graded materials and composites. Additionally, an efficient technique for identifying heterogeneous material properties from in vivo measurements would be useful in biomedical contexts to characterize heterogeneous biological tissues. Although several techniques developed over the past two decades have addressed inverse identification for homogeneous materials, including linear elastic, hyperelastic, viscoelastic, and elastoplastic solids, comparatively fewer studies have considered heterogeneous and graded materials. Furthermore, several recent approaches to characterizing heterogeneous and graded materials employ parameter-heavy, deep learning-based frameworks trained to enforce force equilibrium at specified collocation points within the material. In this work, we propose an interpretable and time-efficient framework that predicts the three-dimensional relative spatial variation of a constitutive parameter field for multiple parameters of a heterogeneous hyperelastic material, using only displacement-field data. In this work, we validate our framework on 3D synthetic and 2D experimental benchmarks involving heterogeneous, graded, and anisotropic hyperelastic materials. By leveraging the linear nature of the inverse problem for hyperelastic materials and directly optimizing for the constitutive parameters at the finite-element level, we achieve acceptable prediction accuracy with significantly lower computational time compared to recently reported deep-learning-based frameworks.
items.abstract_zh: 仅利用实验可获得的位移场和边界反作用力来识别非均质固体空间变化材料属性的反问题仍然具有挑战性。能够表征非均质和梯度固体将有利于功能梯度材料和复合材料的设计与制造。此外，一种从在体测量中识别非均质材料属性的高效技术将在生物医学背景下用于表征非均质生物组织。尽管过去二十年开发的若干技术已解决均质材料的反识别问题，包括线弹性、超弹性、黏弹性和弹塑性固体，但考虑非均质和梯度材料的研究相对较少。此外，近期若干表征非均质和梯度材料的方法采用参数繁重的深度学习框架，通过训练在材料内指定配点处强制力平衡。在这项工作中，我们提出一个可解释且省时的框架，仅使用位移场数据预测非均质超弹性材料多个参数的本构参数场三维相对空间变化。在这项工作中，我们在涉及非均质、梯度和各向异性超弹性材料的三维合成和二维实验基准上验证了该框架。通过利用超弹性材料反问题的线性性质，并在有限元层面直接优化本构参数，我们实现了可接受的预测精度，且与近期报道的基于深度学习的框架相比计算时间显著降低。

items.title_en: Technical Report MEG2text: Beyond Alignment in Non-Invasive Brain-to-Text
items.title_zh: 技术报告 MEG2text：非侵入式脑到文本中超越对齐
items.abstract_en: Non-invasive brain-to-text seeks to recover language from brain activity without surgery. A central challenge is turning learned brain-language representations into accurate word predictions. We present MEG2text, a decoding system that combines corrected training and evaluation, brain-text alignment, a class-balanced word readout, and target-word language-model fusion. On LibriBrain100's word-ranking task, MEG2text reaches 64.12% mean Top-10 balanced accuracy, improving on published MEG-XL by 16.92 percentage points across four corpora, with gains on each corpus. Controlled comparisons show that both implementation corrections and a learned readout contribute to this improvement. Candidate-level analysis reveals that some words receive informative scores yet consistently lose to competing candidates, while an identical-feature comparison shows that learning the classification rule improves decoding without changing the representation. These findings identify the decoding rule as a consequential part of non-invasive brain-to-text and show how system improvements can make better use of aligned neural features.
items.abstract_zh: 非侵入式脑到文本旨在无需手术从大脑活动中恢复语言。一个核心挑战是将学到的脑-语言表示转化为准确的词预测。我们提出 MEG2text，一种解码系统，结合了校正的训练与评估、脑-文本对齐、类别平衡的词读出以及目标词语言模型融合。在 LibriBrain100 的词排序任务上，MEG2text 达到 64.12% 平均 Top-10 平衡准确率，在四个语料库上较已发表的 MEG-XL 提高 16.92 个百分点，且在每个语料库上均有提升。受控比较表明，实现校正和学习得到的读出均有助于这一改进。候选级分析揭示，一些词获得有信息量的分数却持续输给竞争候选；而同特征比较表明，学习分类规则可在不改变表示的情况下改善解码。这些发现将解码规则确定为非侵入式脑到文本中的重要组成部分，并展示系统改进如何更好地利用对齐的神经特征。

items.title_en: SkySearcher: High-Altitude Onboard VLM Reasoning for Aerial Semantic Search
items.title_zh: SkySearcher：用于空中语义搜索的高空机载 VLM 推理
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have improved semantic and visual reasoning, enabling UAVs to search for open-vocabulary queries in unstructured environments at high altitude. However, existing systems mainly follow low-altitude strategies, focusing on close-range iterative exploration, requiring storage-intensive dense 3D metric-semantic reconstructions or relying on large cloud-serviced VLMs assuming constant internet access. We propose SkySearcher, an aerial semantic search navigation method designed for large outdoor scenes. SkySearcher integrates onboard VLM reasoning with a lightweight probabilistic representation that guides an information-driven exploration. The VLM extracts semantic information at high altitude about the target or cues informing about its location. This information is projected to the ground using the camera frustum instead of limited-depth sensors, actively exploiting the expansive field of view offered by elevated sensing. The information regarding the presence or absence of semantic cues is then integrated into a probabilistic map by modeling the spatial belief of the query, maintaining a task-driven memory for the mission and guiding the exploration towards semantically promising regions. Extensive simulations for Aerial Object Goal Navigation on public benchmarks demonstrate that SkySearcher significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in success rate, flight time, and navigation precision, while a deployment of SkySercher running fully onboard a drone demonstrates the applicability of our approach.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）的最新进展改进了语义和视觉推理，使无人机能够在高空非结构化环境中搜索开放词汇查询。然而，现有系统主要遵循低空策略，侧重于近距离迭代探索，需要存储密集的稠密三维度量-语义重建，或依赖假设持续联网的大型云服务 VLM。我们提出 SkySearcher，一种为大型室外场景设计的空中语义搜索导航方法。SkySearcher 将机载 VLM 推理与引导信息驱动探索的轻量级概率表示相结合。VLM 在高空提取关于目标或其位置线索的语义信息。该信息使用相机视锥而非有限深度传感器投影到地面，主动利用高空传感提供的广阔视野。随后，通过建模查询的空间信念，将关于语义线索存在与否的信息整合到概率地图中，为任务维护任务驱动记忆，并引导探索朝向语义上有希望的区域。在公开基准上的空中物体目标导航大量仿真表明，SkySearcher 在成功率、飞行时间和导航精度方面显著优于最先进基线；而在无人机上完全机载运行的 SkySearcher 部署展示了我们方法的适用性。

items.title_en: Evidence-Aligned Benchmarking and Learning for Medical Video Language Models
items.title_zh: 面向医学视频语言模型的证据对齐基准测试与学习
items.abstract_en: A medical video language model should answer from the visual evidence its question asks about. We find three places where this breaks down and address each with an approach we call MedEvidU. First, benchmarks reward answers that ignore the video: on one dataset, the position of a clip within its recording predicts the surgical step in 37% of questions, and a constant answer beats every trained model on a standard safety-assessment metric. We build MedVidBench-v2, 34 tasks from 18 surgical and clinical video datasets, in which prompts and metrics are audited with answers given without video, and which tests unseen hospitals and windows cut blindly from whole recordings. Second, common video encoders merge consecutive frames into shared tokens, so a question about one frame is answered from a blend of two. Query-slot inputs give each queried frame its own tokens at almost no extra cost. Third, a fine-tuned model has memorized its training questions, which leaves little to learn from. Label-matched question resampling (LQR) adds unseen questions about the same recordings while keeping the answer distribution fixed, in a final supervised epoch and in reinforcement learning. Together, these raise the grounding IoU of a 4B model from 30.4 to 44.4, above a supervised 27B model, and instrument grounding at an unseen hospital from 33.9 to 72.5. On blindly cut windows, event-presence accuracy improves by 5.5 points and localization F1 by 8.1 points. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/MedEvidU/
items.abstract_zh: 医学视频语言模型应当根据其问题所询问的视觉证据来回答。我们发现这种能力在三个地方失效，并用一种称为 MedEvidU 的方法逐一解决。第一，基准会奖励忽略视频的答案：在某个数据集上，片段在其录像中的位置能在 37% 的问题中预测手术步骤；在标准安全性评估指标上，一个恒定答案优于所有训练过的模型。我们构建了 MedVidBench-v2，包含来自 18 个外科和临床视频数据集的 34 个任务；其中提示和指标通过在没有视频时给出答案来进行审计，并测试未见医院以及从完整录像中盲目切出的窗口。第二，常见视频编码器将连续帧合并为共享 token，因此关于某一帧的问题会由两帧的混合来回答。查询槽输入以几乎不增加额外成本的方式为每个被查询帧提供其自身的 token。第三，微调后的模型已经记住了其训练问题，因此可供学习的内容很少。标签匹配的问题重采样（LQR）在最后一个监督 epoch 和强化学习中，加入关于相同录像的未见问题，同时保持答案分布固定。这些方法共同将 4B 模型的定位 IoU 从 30.4 提高到 44.4，高于一个监督式 27B 模型，并将未见医院的器械定位从 33.9 提高到 72.5。在盲目切出的窗口上，事件存在准确率提高 5.5 个百分点，定位 F1 提高 8.1 个百分点。项目页面：https://gaozhongpai.github.io/MedEvidU/

items.title_en: Scale-dependent predictability of microscopic brain structure from MRI using paired PS-OCT
items.title_zh: 基于配对 PS-OCT 的 MRI 微观脑结构可预测性随尺度变化
items.abstract_en: Cortical layering, fascicle geometry and tissue texture of the mouse brain lie in the mesoscopic range. That range sits below the hundred-micrometre sampling of a whole-brain magnetic resonance (MR) volume and above the micrometre structure of individual fibre bundles. Polarization-sensitive optical coherence tomography (PS-OCT) reaches into it, and MRI does not. Super-resolution models can enlarge an MR volume to any grid, but the grid size does not decide what the volume contains. We take PS-OCT at 10 um isotropic sampling as the target and ask whether a 100 um MRI volume still carries information about each target band. At each candidate magnification we ask whether the source still determines something about the target band. Two readouts on a shared band index answer it. The bands come from an isotropic spherical-shell decomposition. The energy readout predicts a log-RMS energy envelope, which needs no unobservable phase, and a structural-tensor comparison separates geometric from intensity guidance, with the absolute cosine read against an analytic level of 0.50. On nine paired mouse brains the two readouts do not weaken together. The median absolute cosine falls from 0.864 at 1x to 0.661 at 4x and to 0.518 at 10x, while the R-squared of the energy envelope decays from 0.627 to 0.438 at 4x and to 0.175 at 10x. The two readouts part company at 4x, a target voxel of 25 um, the last of the six candidates at which both conditions hold. Each candidate interrogates a different physical scale. The curves therefore cannot carry a claim about a special frequency, and we report the boundary as the output of a procedure and not as a constant. Two further effects pull the readouts in opposite ways. One is intrinsic to the envelope kernel and accounts for part of the accelerated decay beyond 4x. The other comes from the smoothing applied to the reference before it is scored.
items.abstract_zh: 小鼠大脑的皮层分层、纤维束几何和组织纹理位于介观尺度范围。该范围低于全脑 MR 体积的百微米采样，高于单个纤维束的微米级结构。偏振敏感光学相干层析成像（PS-OCT）可达到该范围，而 MRI 不能。超分辨率模型可将 MR 体积放大到任意网格，但网格大小并不决定该体积包含什么。我们以 10 μm 各向同性采样的 PS-OCT 为目标，并探究 100 μm 的 MRI 体积是否仍携带关于每个目标频带的信息。在每个候选放大倍数下，我们探究源是否仍能决定目标频带的某些信息。在共享频带索引上的两个读出指标回答了该问题。频带来自各向同性球壳分解。能量读出预测对数 RMS 能量包络，该包络不需要不可观测的相位；结构张量比较将几何引导与强度引导分开，并将绝对余弦值与解析水平 0.50 进行比较。在九个配对小鼠大脑上，两个读出指标并非一起减弱。绝对余弦中位数从 1× 时的 0.864 降至 4× 时的 0.661，并在 10× 时降至 0.518；而能量包络的 R 平方从 0.627 衰减到 4× 时的 0.438，并在 10× 时降至 0.175。两个读出指标在 4×（目标体素为 25 μm）处分离，这是六个候选中最后一个两种条件均成立的候选。每个候选探究不同的物理尺度。因此，这些曲线不能支持关于某个特殊频率的论断；我们将边界报告为一个过程的输出，而不是一个常数。另外两种效应以相反方向拉动读出指标。一种内在于包络核，并解释了超过 4× 后加速衰减的一部分。另一种来自在评分前对参考施加的平滑。

items.title_en: Tweezing microparticles by tightly focused optical skyrmionic fields
items.title_zh: 用紧聚焦光学斯格明子场镊取微粒
items.abstract_en: The concept of skyrmions, once translated to the optical domain, provides a topological framework to investigate structured light-matter interactions. However, their practical use for the manipulation of material systems remains barely explored. Here, we experimentally demonstrate trapping and tunable orbital motion of dielectric microparticles in tightly focused skyrmionic polarization textures prepared using a compact spin-orbit optical element. We explore the tweezing capabilities at fixed topology either by varying the relative weights of the orthogonally polarized components or by switching between skyrmion and bimeron polarization textures. Vectorial focusing and optical-force calculations qualitatively reproduce the experimental observations. These results motivate extending skyrmionic light to the manipulation of micro-objects, including birefringent and chiral samples.
items.abstract_zh: 斯格明子的概念一旦被转换到光学领域，就为研究结构光与物质相互作用提供了一个拓扑框架。然而，它们在操控材料系统方面的实际用途仍鲜有探索。在此，我们实验演示了在使用紧凑型自旋-轨道光学元件制备的紧聚焦斯格明子偏振织构中对介电微粒的捕获和可调轨道运动。我们通过改变正交偏振分量的相对权重或在斯格明子和 bimeron 偏振织构之间切换，探索固定拓扑下的光镊能力。矢量聚焦和光力计算定性地再现了实验观察。这些结果推动将斯格明子光扩展到微物体操控，包括双折射和手性样品。

items.title_en: Decision-Aligned Value Learning for Selective Adoption of EEG Fusion in Human-Robot Collaboration
items.title_zh: 面向人-机器人协作中选择性采用脑电融合的决策对齐价值学习
items.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) captures neural activity associated with human perception and decision-making. It provides human-robot collaboration (HRC) systems with measurable evidence for event recognition, situation assessment, and action preparation. External sensing cannot easily provide such evidence. However, the quality and complementarity of this evidence vary across samples, and existing EEG fusion methods do not explicitly determine when EEG improves a prediction. We therefore framed selective EEG use as a sample-wise incremental-value estimation problem and proposed Value Estimation and Constraint-Aware Triage for Adoption (VECTA). VECTA separates the generation of an EEG-informed Fusion prediction from the decision about whether it should replace the existing Base prediction. The framework uses system gain to quantify the loss reduction from Base to Fusion and matching gain to assess whether benefits arise from sample-matched EEG. A signed-value learner estimates system gain from decision-time evidence and prioritizes high-value Fusion outputs under budget constraints. Cross-subject evaluations on three HRC datasets showed that matched Fusion outperformed shuffled controls. Estimated gains tracked realized gains, with Spearman correlations of 0.347-0.612 and positive-gain areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROCs) of 0.708-0.842. Under budget constraints, VECTA reduced Brier loss and harmful Fusion adoption and achieved the highest mean normalized AUBC across three datasets among the selective-decision methods evaluated. Validation on three external multi-modal datasets showed that VECTA could be applied directly as a post-hoc decision layer to task-specific predictors without retraining. These results show that selective Fusion adoption can translate the uneven utility of EEG into system-level gains.
items.abstract_zh: 脑电图（EEG）捕获与人类感知和决策相关的神经活动。它为人-机器人协作（HRC）系统提供用于事件识别、情境评估和动作准备的可测量证据。外部传感难以轻易提供此类证据。然而，这种证据的质量和互补性因样本而异，现有 EEG 融合方法并未明确判断 EEG 何时能改善预测。因此，我们将选择性使用 EEG 构建为逐样本增量价值估计问题，并提出了用于采用的价值估计与约束感知分流（VECTA）。VECTA 将生成脑电信息融合预测与决定其是否应替代现有基础预测分开。该框架使用系统增益来量化从基础预测到融合预测的损失降低，并使用匹配增益来评估收益是否来自样本匹配的 EEG。带符号价值学习器从决策时证据估计系统增益，并在预算约束下优先输出高价值融合结果。在三个 HRC 数据集上的跨被试评估显示，匹配融合优于打乱对照。估计增益与实现增益一致，Spearman 相关系数为 0.347–0.612，正增益的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为 0.708–0.842。在预算约束下，VECTA 降低了 Brier 损失和有害融合采用，并在所评估的选择性决策方法中，在三个数据集上取得最高的平均归一化 AUBC。在三个外部多模态数据集上的验证表明，VECTA 可直接作为事后决策层应用于任务特定预测器而无需重新训练。这些结果表明，选择性融合采用可以将 EEG 的不均匀效用转化为系统级增益。

items.title_en: Where Does the Asymmetry Enter? Staging a Fairness Audit Across a Fused Multimodal Moderation Pipeline
items.title_zh: 不对称从何处进入？在一体化多模态审核流水线上分阶段实施公平性审计
items.abstract_en: Almost every short-video upload now passes through a classifier that fuses video, speech, and on-screen text into one decision about whether it may be seen. It moderates every language community on the platform at once, and fairness across them is judged, if at all, from one accuracy score. That score is compatible with error falling almost entirely on one language group. An audit that goes looking reads the model's decisions, the last stage of a long pipeline and the one whose test has the fewest items. We ask where in a fused pipeline a subgroup asymmetry can be detected at all: in what the classifier may read, in what its branches encode, or in what it decides. We answer this with a post-hoc audit of a published TikTok classifier, holding all three stages to one significance standard using only its logged decisions, labels, and pre-fusion features, with source language as the subgroup axis. The asymmetry is significant at the stage deciding what the model may read, and again in what the text branch encodes. At the earlier stage, a language-blind cap admits less of a Vietnamese clip than an English one, for reasons of segmentation, not verbosity. The asymmetry is undetectable at the decision, where the smallest subgroup leaves twelve items to test. An audit reading only decisions looks where its evidence is thinnest; the same test staged upstream recovers a disparity the decision-level view returns as noise.
items.abstract_zh: 如今几乎每个短视频上传都会经过一个分类器，该分类器将视频、语音和屏幕文本融合为关于其是否可见的一个决定。它同时审核平台上的每个语言社区，而跨社区的公平性（如果有的话）仅通过一个准确率分数来判断。该分数可能与错误几乎完全落在一个语言群体上的情况相容。一项主动探查的审计读取的是模型的决定，即长流水线的最后阶段，也是测试项目最少的阶段。我们追问：在融合流水线中，子组不对称究竟能在何处被检测到——在分类器可读取的内容中、在其分支所编码的内容中，还是在其所决定的内容中。我们通过对一个已发表的 TikTok 分类器进行事后审计来回答这一问题，仅使用其记录的决策、标签和融合前特征，将三个阶段置于同一显著性标准下，并以源语言作为子组轴。不对称在决定模型可读取内容的阶段显著，在文本分支所编码的内容中也显著。在较早阶段，语言盲的上限使越南语视频片段比英语视频片段准入更少，原因是分割，而非冗长。在决策阶段，不对称无法检测到，因为最小子组仅留下十二个项目可供检验。仅读取决策的审计关注其证据最薄弱之处；同一检验若在上游分阶段实施，则可恢复出决策级视角视为噪声的差异。

items.title_en: xFORM: Accelerating Fixed-Lag LiDAR Odometry with Exact Factor Compression
items.title_zh: xFORM：利用精确因子压缩加速固定滞后 LiDAR 里程计
items.abstract_en: Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) sensors are increasingly popular for state estimation because of their precision, long range, and high measurement rate. Unfortunately, LiDAR Odometry (LO) systems incur substantial computational cost when processing large point clouds, particularly those that jointly refine a window of scan poses. While our prior LO work FORM is real-time, the costs of feature extraction, correspondence search, and the evaluation and linearization of residuals during pose optimization can introduce significant latency. This latency makes downstream tasks such as control and path planning difficult. To overcome this, we present xFORM, which accelerates the three stages of FORM. xFORM uses factor compression to reduce an optimization problem involving hundreds of thousands of feature matches to 34 scalar residuals per scan pair, while preserving the original objective and Gauss-Newton system in exact arithmetic. We integrate this optimizer into two variants: xFORM-CPU, which additionally parallelizes feature extraction on the CPU, and xFORM-GPU, which accelerates feature processing, correspondence search, and factor compression on the GPU. Across fifteen complete sequences from three datasets, xFORM-CPU and xFORM-GPU achieve overall speedups of 1.1-1.4$\times$ and 2.0-4.0$\times$ over FORM, respectively, with no numerically significant differences to the original implementation.
items.abstract_zh: 光探测与测距（LiDAR）传感器因其精度、远距离和高测量速率而在状态估计中越来越受欢迎。不幸的是，LiDAR 里程计（LO）系统在处理大型点云时会产生大量计算成本，尤其是那些联合优化一个扫描位姿窗口的系统。虽然我们之前的 LO 工作 FORM 是实时的，但特征提取、对应搜索以及位姿优化期间残差的评估和线性化的成本可能引入显著延迟。这种延迟使控制和路径规划等下游任务变得困难。为克服这一点，我们提出 xFORM，它加速 FORM 的三个阶段。xFORM 使用因子压缩，将涉及数十万特征匹配的优化问题缩减为每对扫描 34 个标量残差，同时在精确算术中保留原始目标和 Gauss-Newton 系统。我们将该优化器集成到两个变体中：xFORM-CPU，额外在 CPU 上并行化特征提取；以及 xFORM-GPU，在 GPU 上加速特征处理、对应搜索和因子压缩。在来自三个数据集的十五条完整序列上，xFORM-CPU 和 xFORM-GPU 相对于 FORM 分别实现 1.1–1.4 倍和 2.0–4.0 倍的总体加速，且与原始实现无数值显著差异。

items.title_en: Fewer Fractions, Equieffective Plans: An optimization framework based on equieffective dose
items.title_zh: 更少分次，等效计划：基于等效剂量的优化框架
items.abstract_en: Background: Non-standard fractionation requires caution before clinical use, and planners often need to manually modify the prescription and dose constraints for non-linear biological effects. Purpose: To develop an extension within a treatment planning system that enables the generation of hypofractionated plans based on equieffective dose, $EQD_{n_{ref}}$, for an alternative fractionation deliverable in $n$ fractions, such that it is equieffective with the reference fractionation for a specified biological endpoint. Methods: A research build of RayStation v2025 was extended to optimize $EQD_{n_{ref}}$ plans. This study used anonymized data from three head and neck patients. $\text{CTV}_p$ and $\text{CTV}_n$ were prescribed 70 Gy and 54 Gy in 35 fractions. Targets, spinal cord, and brainstem were robustly optimized for $\pm3.5$% density and $\pm3.0$ mm setup uncertainties. For each patient, hypofractionated plans were created with 34, 32, 30, and 25 fractions. Sensitivity analysis evaluated the impact of $α/β$ uncertainty. Results: All equieffective hypofractionated plans maintained target coverage and met mandatory clinical goals for organs-at-risk (OARs). Compared to standard fractionation, DVH parameters indicated an average $ΔEQD_{n_{ref}}$ <0.2 Gy for $\text{CTV}_p$ and no difference for $\text{CTV}_n$. For parallel OARs, the median mean-dose difference between hypofractionation (to 30 fractions) and standard fractionation was generally <1% of the prescribed dose. $α/β$ uncertainty produced the greatest variation in the 25-fraction regimen, with absolute $ΔEQD_{n_{ref}}$ up to 0.88 Gy for targets and up to 0.63 Gy for the spinal cord and brainstem. Conclusions: An $EQD_{n_{ref}}$-based framework can generate equieffective hypofractionated plans, making it feasible to reduce fractions without substantially deviating from existing clinical protocols.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：非标准分次在临床使用前需要谨慎，计划设计者通常需要针对非线性生物效应手动修改处方和剂量约束。目的：在治疗计划系统内开发一个扩展，使其能够基于等效剂量 $EQD_{n_{ref}}$ 生成大分次计划，该计划可在 $n$ 次分次中实施，并在指定生物终点上与参考分次方案等效。方法：扩展 RayStation v2025 的研究版本以优化 $EQD_{n_{ref}}$ 计划。本研究使用三名头颈部患者的匿名数据。$\text{CTV}_p$ 和 $\text{CTV}_n$ 处方为 35 次分次给予 70 Gy 和 54 Gy。靶区、脊髓和脑干针对 $\pm3.5$% 密度和 $\pm3.0$ mm 摆位不确定性进行鲁棒优化。为每名患者创建了 34、32、30 和 25 次分次的大分次计划。敏感性分析评估了 $α/β$ 不确定性的影响。结果：所有等效大分次计划均维持了靶区覆盖，并满足危及器官（OAR）的强制性临床目标。与标准分次相比，DVH 参数显示 $\text{CTV}_p$ 的平均 $ΔEQD_{n_{ref}}$ <0.2 Gy，$\text{CTV}_n$ 无差异。对于并行 OAR，大分次（至 30 次分次）与标准分次之间的中位平均剂量差异通常小于处方剂量的 1%。$α/β$ 不确定性在 25 次分次方案中产生最大变化，靶区的绝对 $ΔEQD_{n_{ref}}$ 高达 0.88 Gy，脊髓和脑干高达 0.63 Gy。结论：基于 $EQD_{n_{ref}}$ 的框架能够生成等效大分次计划，使得在不显著偏离现有临床方案的情况下减少分次数成为可行。

items.title_en: Functional balance between inhibitory and disinhibitory pathways predicts the heterogeneous effects of arousal on cortical timescales
items.title_zh: 抑制性与去抑制通路之间的功能平衡预测唤醒对皮层时间尺度的异质性影响
items.abstract_en: Cortical activity exhibits diverse timescales that vary with behavioral state, but the underlying circuit mechanisms remain unclear. Analyzing Allen Institute Neuropixels recordings from mouse primary visual cortex, we found that the fraction of excitatory neurons activated by optogenetic stimulation of somatostatin (SST) interneurons varied across mice. Intrinsic timescales lengthened during arousal in mice with a lower fraction of activated excitatory neurons and shortened in those with a higher fraction. To investigate a possible mechanism, we trained spiking networks with cell-type-specific plasticity, producing configurations dominated by direct SST inhibition of excitatory neurons or indirect disinhibition via parvalbumin interneurons. Arousal-like input to vasoactive intestinal peptide (VIP) interneurons slowed assembly dynamics, lengthened intrinsic timescales, and accelerated assembly formation when direct inhibition dominated, with opposite effects when indirect disinhibition dominated. Our results suggest that the balance between these pathways can account for opposite timescale responses to arousal and shape its computational consequences.
items.abstract_zh: 皮层活动表现出多种时间尺度，并随行为状态变化，但潜在环路机制仍不清楚。分析艾伦研究所小鼠初级视觉皮层的 Neuropixels 记录，我们发现通过光遗传学刺激生长抑素（SST）中间神经元所激活的兴奋性神经元比例在小鼠之间不同。在激活兴奋性神经元比例较低的小鼠中，内在时间尺度在唤醒期间延长；而在比例较高的小鼠中则缩短。为研究可能机制，我们训练了具有细胞类型特异性可塑性的脉冲网络，产生以 SST 对兴奋性神经元的直接抑制为主、或以经小清蛋白中间神经元的间接去抑制为主的配置。当直接抑制占主导时，对血管活性肠肽（VIP）中间神经元的类唤醒输入减慢集合动力学、延长内在时间尺度并加速集合形成；当间接去抑制占主导时则产生相反效应。我们的结果表明，这些通路之间的平衡可以解释对唤醒的相反时间尺度响应，并塑造其计算后果。

items.title_en: QuOptLab: Advancing Quantum Optics Experiments with an AI Agent
items.title_zh: QuOptLab：利用 AI 智能体推进量子光学实验
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in AI-assisted theoretical research suggest that AI agents can contribute to research-level problems. Whether they can also advance experimental research by conducting experiments, analyzing the results, and proposing better experimental designs remains an open question. To address this question, we build a simulated quantum optics laboratory and integrate it with an AI agent in QuOptLab. The laboratory includes optical instruments, a robotic arm, and cameras, enabling the agent to carry out and iteratively refine experiments. We consider two complementary tasks: thin-film thickness measurement in free-space optics and edge-coupler design in integrated photonics. In the thin-film thickness measurement task, the agent repeatedly analyzes measurement results and revises its measurement method, including calibration and data analysis, reducing thickness-estimation error from 7.13 to 0.066~nm$^2$ over six epochs in a classical-interference run. For edge-coupler design, the agent iteratively proposes structural modifications, evaluates the resulting coupling performance, and uses the feedback to guide subsequent revisions, increasing simulated coupling efficiency from 85.81% to 91.98%.
items.abstract_zh: 近期 AI 辅助理论研究的进展表明，AI 智能体可以为研究级问题作出贡献。它们能否通过执行实验、分析结果并提出更好的实验设计来推进实验研究，仍是一个开放问题。为解决这一问题，我们构建了一个仿真量子光学实验室，并在 QuOptLab 中将其与 AI 智能体集成。该实验室包括光学仪器、机械臂和相机，使智能体能够执行并迭代改进实验。我们考虑两个互补任务：自由空间光学中的薄膜厚度测量和集成光子学中的边缘耦合器设计。在薄膜厚度测量任务中，智能体反复分析测量结果并修改其测量方法，包括校准和数据分析，在经典干涉运行中经过六个轮次将厚度估计误差从 7.13 降低到 0.066~nm$^2$。对于边缘耦合器设计，智能体迭代提出结构修改，评估所得耦合性能，并利用反馈指导后续修改，将仿真耦合效率从 85.81% 提高到 91.98%。

items.title_en: Decentralized Clustered Federated Learning for Cellular Traffic Forecasting over LEO Constellations
items.title_zh: 面向 LEO 星座蜂窝流量预测的去中心化聚类联邦学习
items.abstract_en: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations are positioned to act as orbital edge-compute nodes in emerging 6G non-terrestrial networks, supporting forecasting and control tasks for ground cellular infrastructure. However, training such models is challenged by heterogeneous ground-cell traffic patterns, intermittent links to ground stations, and the satellites' own orbital motion, which continuously shifts the data each satellite observes. In this work, we extend Decentralized Federated Clustering (DFCA) to the LEO setting and apply it to cellular internet-traffic forecasting on the Telecom Italia Milan+Trentino dataset. Satellites cooperate exclusively through $k$-nearest inter-satellite gossip with no ground-side aggregator, while zero-shot head selection lets each satellite specialize to the latent traffic regime of the ground cell currently beneath it. Averaged over $K{=}20$ post-training orbital snapshots, our extension reduces forecasting Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) by $15.3\%$ over a decentralized FedAvg baseline of equivalent capacity, with cluster recovery accuracy of $85.3\%$. The results indicate that clustered specialization yields measurable gains under the structural heterogeneity inherent to realistic cellular-over-LEO scenarios.
items.abstract_zh: 低地球轨道（LEO）卫星星座有望在新兴 6G 非地面网络中充当轨道边缘计算节点，支持地面蜂窝基础设施的预测与控制任务。然而，训练此类模型面临挑战：地面小区流量模式异构、与地面站的链路间歇性中断，以及卫星自身轨道运动持续改变每颗卫星观测到的数据。在本工作中，我们将去中心化联邦聚类（DFCA）扩展到 LEO 场景，并将其应用于 Telecom Italia Milan+Trentino 数据集上的蜂窝互联网流量预测。卫星仅通过 $k$ 近邻星间 gossip 进行合作，没有地面侧聚合器；同时，零样本头部选择使每颗卫星专门适应当前位于其下方的地面小区的潜在流量模式。在 $K{=}20$ 个训练后轨道快照上平均，我们的扩展相较于同等容量的去中心化 FedAvg 基线将预测均方根误差（RMSE）降低了 $15.3\%$，聚类恢复准确率为 $85.3\%$。结果表明，在现实蜂窝 over LEO 场景固有的结构异质性下，聚类专门化带来了可测量的增益。

items.title_en: Mitigating Hallucinations in Medical Question Answering on ESC Cardiology Guidelines: Evaluation and Retrieval Optimization
items.title_zh: 减轻 ESC 心脏病学指南医学问答中的幻觉：评估与检索优化
items.abstract_en: Background: Large language models produce hallucinations in medical question answering (QA). Verify-and-revise pipelines that check atomic claims against retrieved guideline evidence are a standard mitigation, but evaluations almost universally treat the verifier's output as ground truth, an assumption rarely tested. Objective: To measure, claim by claim against human judgement, how such a pipeline fails in a guideline-grounded clinical setting. Methods: We built a dataset of 160 questions (100 patient vignettes from 89 de-identified cases, 60 fact-based) over four recent ESC cardiology guidelines, all approved by a practising internist, and a retrieval corpus of 627 hand-verified guideline records at two chunk granularities. A five-stage pipeline was run under four retrieval configurations and three independent runs (1920 arm-runs); all 606 first-pass refuted claims were manually audited, an independent judge re-judged 906 decisions, and the expert blindly reviewed 100 accepted claims. Results: Only 44.7-50.6% of flagged claims were true hallucinations. Correction loops converged in 85.2-95.1% of cases, yet 35% of genuine final errors were introduced by correction. Single-run true-hallucination recall was 35.6-41.2%, the three-run union 71-80%; verifier agreement was moderate (kappa = 0.505). The blind probe estimated the accepted-claim miss rate at 3.2% (95% CI 0.7-6.7%). Final genuine-error rate: 1.7% of answers. Conclusion: Claim-level verification reduces hallucinated content by an order of magnitude, but verifier reliability, not generation, is the limiting factor and must be measured, not assumed.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：大语言模型在医学问答（QA）中会产生幻觉。通过检索到的指南证据核查原子主张的“验证并修订”流程是一种标准缓解措施，但评估几乎普遍将验证器输出视为真值，这一假设很少被检验。目的：以人类判断为对照，逐条主张测量此类流程在以指南为基础的临床环境中如何失败。方法：我们围绕四份近期 ESC 心脏病学指南构建了一个包含 160 个问题的数据集（100 个来自 89 个去标识化病例的患者情景题，60 个事实型问题），均由一位执业内科医生审核批准；并构建了一个检索语料库，包含 627 条经人工核验的指南记录，覆盖两种分块粒度。一个五阶段流程在四种检索配置和三次独立运行下运行（1920 次分支运行）；所有 606 条首轮被驳斥的主张均经人工审计，一位独立评审者重新评判了 906 项决定，专家盲审了 100 条被接受的主张。结果：被标记的主张中仅 44.7-50.6% 是真正的幻觉。纠正循环在 85.2-95.1% 的案例中收敛，但 35% 的真实最终错误是由纠正引入的。单次运行的真幻觉召回率为 35.6-41.2%，三次运行的并集为 71-80%；验证器一致性为中等（kappa = 0.505）。盲探估计被接受主张的漏检率为 3.2%（95% CI 0.7-6.7%）。最终真实错误率：占答案的 1.7%。结论：主张级验证将幻觉内容减少了一个数量级，但限制因素是验证器可靠性而非生成，必须测量而非假设。

items.title_en: FailPoint-X: A Policy-Matched, Failure-Anchored Benchmark for Offline VLA Post-Training from Human Takeovers
items.title_zh: FailPoint-X：面向人类接管离线 VLA 后训练的策略匹配、失败锚定基准
items.abstract_en: Human takeovers offer corrective supervision for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, but their contribution to offline post-training must be separated from that of continued optimization. We introduce FailPoint-X, a benchmark for offline VLA post-training with human takeovers. To represent uncertainty in failure onset, an annotator marks an interval for each failure, and training takeovers start at seeded frames sampled within it. From one fixed $π_{0.5}$ checkpoint, which also initializes post-training, we assemble 629 natural failures across 10 LIBERO-X task families at up to five difficulty levels. All 2,823 takeover attempts are logged; 2,400 are accepted recoveries, of which 2,320 are used for post-training. Evaluation restarts every method from the fixed midpoints of 384 held-out failure intervals. Under matched actor-update counts, we compare behavior cloning of recoveries, value-based offline learning on recoveries and failed rollouts, and continued training on existing demonstrations. Within 1,200 steps on the 240 L1-L3 held-out failures, cloning improves recovery by 29.4 percentage points (pp) over the demonstration-only control; the value-based learner does not establish a further gain (1.5 pp). In exploratory evaluation from L1-L5 nominal starts at the same horizon, cloning loses 30.0 pp of success relative to the base policy; mixing in demonstrations reduces the loss to 16.5 pp, a reduction that shrinks under a stricter, pre-specified horizon. Restorable failure states and a shared evaluator let all methods be compared from identical starts.
items.abstract_zh: 人类接管为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略提供纠正性监督，但其对离线后训练的贡献必须与持续优化的贡献区分开。我们提出 FailPoint-X，一个用于人类接管下离线 VLA 后训练的基准。为表示失败起始的不确定性，标注者为每次失败标记一个区间，训练用接管从该区间内采样的种子帧开始。从一个固定的 $π_{0.5}$ 检查点（该检查点也用于初始化后训练）出发，我们汇集了 10 个 LIBERO-X 任务家族、最多五个难度级别的 629 次自然失败。所有 2,823 次接管尝试均被记录；2,400 次为被接受的恢复，其中 2,320 次用于后训练。评估从 384 个留出失败区间的固定中点重新启动每种方法。在匹配的 actor 更新次数下，我们比较了对恢复数据的行为克隆、在恢复和失败轨迹上的基于价值的离线学习，以及在现有示范上的持续训练。在 240 个 L1-L3 留出失败上，克隆在 1,200 步内将恢复率相较于仅示范对照组提高了 29.4 个百分点（pp）；基于价值的学习器未确立进一步增益（1.5 pp）。在相同时间范围的 L1-L5 名义起点探索性评估中，克隆相对于基础策略损失了 30.0 pp 的成功率；混入示范将损失降低到 16.5 pp，而在更严格的预先指定时间范围下该降低幅度会缩小。可恢复的失败状态和共享评估器使所有方法能够从相同起点进行比较。

items.title_en: Who Is Ego? Scaling Cross-View Camera Wearer Identification and Segmentation beyond Humans
items.title_zh: 谁是 Ego？将跨视角相机佩戴者识别与分割扩展到人类之外
items.abstract_en: A first-person (ego) image reveals what a camera sees, but not who or what carries it. Given a synchronized third-person (exo) image, camera wearer identification asks who is ego: which candidate carries the ego camera? We extend this task beyond humans to robots, vehicles, animals, and drones, and broaden its spatial scope (where is ego) from selecting a provided candidate mask to wearer segmentation with absence prediction and mutual camera localization across ego-exo views. We introduce FindEgo-1M, comprising 1.16M real and simulated ego-exo pairs across 12 wearer types, 17 domains, and 111 test settings. Our approach exploits a geometric relation: the ego camera's projection into the exo image, i.e., the epipole, lies on or near its wearer. We introduce EgoRay-ZS, the first method to turn a frozen feed-forward 3D reconstruction model, VGGT-$Ω$, into a training-free solution for wearer identification and segmentation. Its geometric readout ranks candidate masks or segmentation proposals by angular offset and distance to the ego camera, while the relative pose provides mutual camera directions. We then develop the full EgoRay model through pose-supervised training on FindEgo-1M and label-free test-time adaptation constrained by candidate masks. Without task-specific training, EgoRay-ZS achieves 78.0% identification accuracy on TF2023's original labels, versus 52.9% reported for the dataset-trained PEN. On FindEgo-1M, EgoRay achieves state-of-the-art chance-corrected accuracy of 87.1 and 77.7 on seen and unseen settings. On matched queries, EgoRay also outperforms GPT-6 Astra by 31.6 and 21.3 points on seen and unseen settings, respectively, while running $18\times$ faster. Data, code, and models will be released.
items.abstract_zh: 第一人称（ego）图像揭示了相机看到了什么，但没有揭示是谁或什么携带了它。给定同步的第三人称（exo）图像，相机佩戴者识别要回答谁是 ego：哪个候选对象携带 ego 相机？我们将该任务从人类扩展到机器人、车辆、动物和无人机，并将其空间范围（ego 在哪里）从选择给定候选掩码扩展为带缺席预测的佩戴者分割，以及跨 ego-exo 视角的相互相机定位。我们提出 FindEgo-1M，包含 116 万对真实与仿真的 ego-exo 图像对，覆盖 12 种佩戴者类型、17 个领域和 111 种测试设置。我们的方法利用一种几何关系：ego 相机在 exo 图像中的投影，即对极点，位于其佩戴者身上或附近。我们提出 EgoRay-ZS，这是首个将冻结的前馈 3D 重建模型 VGGT-$Ω$ 转化为无需训练的佩戴者识别与分割方案的方法。其几何读出根据与 ego 相机的角度偏移和距离对候选掩码或分割提议进行排序，而相对位姿提供相互相机方向。随后，我们通过在 FindEgo-1M 上进行位姿监督训练，并在候选掩码约束下进行无标签测试时自适应，开发了完整的 EgoRay 模型。在无需任务特定训练的情况下，EgoRay-ZS 在 TF2023 原始标签上达到 78.0% 的识别准确率，而据报道，在该数据集上训练的 PEN 为 52.9%。在 FindEgo-1M 上，EgoRay 在已见和未见设置下分别达到 87.1 和 77.7 的最优机会校正准确率。在匹配查询上，EgoRay 在已见和未见设置下分别比 GPT-6 Astra 高出 31.6 和 21.3 个百分点，同时运行速度快 $18\times$。数据、代码和模型将发布。

items.title_en: Ongoing activity in anatomically recurrent cortex is predominantly feedforward
items.title_zh: 解剖学上递归皮层中的持续活动以前馈为主
items.abstract_en: The cerebral cortex is the major site of computation in the brain, and its recurrent wiring has motivated models in which repeated neuronal activation maintains information in stable attractor states. Large language models illustrate an alternative principle by transforming information layer by layer during each forward pass. A first step toward understanding what cortex and these models can teach us about each other is to establish whether feedforward dynamics can predominate in recurrent cortex. Here, we show that ongoing activity in the frontal cortex of awake mice is composed of parabolic neuronal avalanches in which activity progresses mainly through newly recruited neurons. Using two-photon calcium imaging in hundreds of simultaneously recorded layer II/III pyramidal neurons, we decomposed avalanche size into the number of participating neurons, mean activations per participant, and mean inferred spikes per activation. Avalanche size grew approximately quadratically with duration up to 0.5 s, primarily through recruitment of additional neurons. Participating neurons contributed close to one spike per avalanche on average. Newly recruited neurons also dominated the rise and fall of the average avalanche profile. An unbiased recruitment model, in which all neurons have the same selection probability, accounted for the predominance of new over repeat participation, showing that feedforward recruitment can dominate even when previously active neurons remain available for reactivation. Parabolic avalanches thus express predominantly feedforward dynamics within anatomically recurrent cortex. Cortical computation may therefore have more in common with feedforward processing in large language models than recurrent anatomy alone would suggest.
items.abstract_zh: 大脑皮层是大脑中计算的主要部位，其递归连接促成了这样的模型：重复的神经元激活将信息维持在稳定的吸引子状态。大语言模型展示了另一种原理：在每次前向传递中逐层变换信息。要理解皮层和这些模型能相互教给我们什么，第一步是确定前馈动力学能否在递归皮层中占主导。在这里，我们表明清醒小鼠额叶皮层中的持续活动由抛物线型神经元雪崩组成，其中活动主要通过新招募的神经元推进。利用对数百个同时记录的 II/III 层锥体神经元进行双光子钙成像，我们将雪崩大小分解为参与神经元数量、每个参与者的平均激活次数以及每次激活的平均推断脉冲数。雪崩大小随持续时间（至多 0.5 s）近似二次增长，主要通过招募额外神经元实现。参与神经元平均每次雪崩贡献接近一个脉冲。新招募的神经元也主导了平均雪崩曲线的上升和下降。一个无偏招募模型——其中所有神经元具有相同的选择概率——解释了新参与超过重复参与的主导地位，表明即使先前活跃的神经元仍可被重新激活，前馈招募仍能占主导。因此，抛物线型雪崩在解剖学上递归的皮层内主要表达前馈动力学。因此，皮层计算与大语言模型中的前馈处理之间的共同点，可能比仅凭递归解剖结构所暗示的更多。

items.title_en: Voltage-Enhanced Photorefractive Hysteresis in Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Photonic-Crystal Cavities
items.title_zh: 薄膜铌酸锂光子晶体腔中电压增强的光折变滞回
items.abstract_en: We observe voltage-enhanced photorefractive hysteresis in thin-film lithium niobate nanocavities, causing the resonance to appear at different wavelengths during increasing- and decreasing-wavelength laser scans. Their separation grows with bias magnitude and optical power, but depends weakly on scan speed over 1-200 nm/s. A quasi-static surface-trap model links voltage-biased carrier transport to asymmetric trapping, whose space-charge field shifts the resonance through the Pockels effect. The model captures this hysteresis across three cavities through switching between stable steady states. Space-charge feedback opposes further carrier separation, limiting the hysteresis gap. The model informs photorefractive mitigation and resonance control in integrated electro-optic devices.
items.abstract_zh: 我们观察到薄膜铌酸锂纳米腔中的电压增强光折变滞回，使得在波长增加和减少的激光扫描期间，谐振出现在不同波长。其间隔随偏置幅度和光功率增大，但在 1–200 nm/s 范围内对扫描速度依赖较弱。一个准静态表面陷阱模型将电压偏置的载流子输运与不对称俘获联系起来，其空间电荷场通过普克尔斯效应移动谐振。该模型通过稳定稳态之间的切换，在三个腔中捕捉到这种滞回。空间电荷反馈阻碍载流子进一步分离，从而限制滞回间隙。该模型为集成电光器件中的光折变抑制和谐振控制提供依据。

items.title_en: RHOPE: LLM-Augmented Adaptive Experimental Design with Complex Contextual Information
items.title_zh: RHOPE：具有复杂上下文信息的大语言模型增强自适应实验设计
items.abstract_en: Experimental design allocates limited measurement effort across candidate treatments to learn their expected outcomes. Adaptive designs refine allocations as evidence accumulates, improving estimation and treatment selection. Contextual information can inform these decisions, but exploiting unstructured or high-dimensional context remains challenging. We use large language models (LLMs) to transform complex context into proxy outcomes and propose Residual Horizon Optimization for Prediction-Powered Experimentation (RHOPE), a principled Bayesian adaptive experimentation framework that combines true outcomes with LLM-generated proxy outcomes and formulates finite-batch design as a posterior Markov decision process (MDP). Our methodology uses proxy outcomes in two ways: sample augmentation improves estimation precision, while observing proxies before each allocation decision provides advance information. Synthetic experiments and semi-synthetic experiments using Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC) data suggest that estimation precision drives most gains, with smaller advance-information gains, and highlight the importance of proxy informativeness and moment-estimation accuracy.
items.abstract_zh: 实验设计将有限的测量投入分配到候选处理上，以学习其预期结果。自适应设计随着证据积累而细化分配，从而改进估计和处理选择。上下文信息可为这些决策提供依据，但利用非结构化或高维上下文仍具挑战性。我们使用大语言模型（LLM）将复杂上下文转换为代理结果，并提出用于预测驱动实验的残差时域优化（RHOPE），这是一个有理论依据的贝叶斯自适应实验框架，它将真实结果与 LLM 生成的代理结果相结合，并将有限批次设计表述为后验马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。我们的方法以两种方式使用代理结果：样本增广提高估计精度，而在每次分配决策前观察代理结果可提供提前信息。合成实验和使用癌症药物敏感性基因组学（GDSC）数据的半合成实验表明，估计精度驱动了大部分增益，提前信息带来的增益较小，并凸显了代理信息量和矩估计准确性的重要性。

items.title_en: Learning from Unreliable Operator References: Claim-Level Rewards for Customer Support Agents
items.title_zh: 从不可靠的人工坐席参考中学习：面向客户支持智能体的主张级奖励
items.abstract_en: Even a correct operator reply can be an unreliable training target for a customer-support agent. About a quarter of the factual claims in these replies lacked full support in the agent's knowledge base and tool records. We treat operator replies as claims to verify rather than answers to imitate. Unverified claims guide revisions to the knowledge base and tools. Verified claims serve as coverage targets in a claim-level GRPO reward that scores factual precision against the evidence the agent retrieved for its answer. On an offline benchmark, 8.6% of the GRPO agent's text answers were flagged for hallucinations, compared with 13.6% for the supervised fine-tuning baseline. In a randomized A/B test against the existing procedural bot, the deployed system increased the share of conversations closed without a human operator from 63.3% to 80.8%.
items.abstract_zh: 即使是正确的人工坐席回复，也可能成为客户支持智能体不可靠的训练目标。这些回复中约四分之一的事实性主张在智能体的知识库和工具记录中缺乏充分支持。我们将人工坐席回复视为需要验证的主张，而非需要模仿的答案。未经验证的主张指导知识库和工具的修订。经验证的主张在主张级 GRPO 奖励中作为覆盖目标，该奖励根据智能体为其答案检索到的证据对事实精确率进行评分。在离线基准上，GRPO 智能体有 8.6% 的文本答案被标记为幻觉，而监督微调基线为 13.6%。在与现有流程式机器人的随机 A/B 测试中，部署系统将无需人工坐席即可关闭的对话比例从 63.3% 提高到 80.8%。

items.title_en: Model Predictive Control of a Multirotor UAV with a Cable-Suspended Payload: A Comparison of Shifted and Transformer-Based Warm Starts
items.title_zh: 缆索悬挂载荷多旋翼无人机的模型预测控制：移位式与基于 Transformer 的热启动比较
items.abstract_en: This study investigates model predictive control (MPC) of a multirotor drone (unmanned aerial vehicle, UAV) carrying a cable-suspended payload, comparing conventional shifted initialization with Transformer-based warm starting of a sequential convex programming (SCP) optimizer. The controller uses a coupled mechanical model with an elastic cable and a double-pendulum representation of the suspended load. Its formulation includes move-blocked control inputs, finite-difference sensitivities, constrained quadratic subproblems, and input-feasibility projection. A Transformer trained on expert SCP solutions predicts an initial control sequence, which is subsequently refined by the same optimizer used for the conventional methods. Numerical experiments compare zero, shifted, and Transformer initialization under identical controller settings. For independently solved MPC problems, Transformer initialization reduces computation time relative to zero initialization. In sequential closed-loop simulations, however, shifting the preceding optimized control sequence provides the lowest computation time, while all three methods produce similar tracking behavior. These findings emphasize the importance of comparing learned warm starts with conventional initialization methods that reuse previous MPC solutions. The measured optimization times exceed the control sampling period; consequently, real-time implementation is not demonstrated. Keywords: Model predictive control; sequential convex programming; Transformer; warm start; cable-suspended payload; multirotor drone.
items.abstract_zh: 本研究考察携带缆索悬挂载荷的多旋翼无人机（无人驾驶航空器，UAV）的模型预测控制（MPC），比较传统的移位初始化与序列凸规划（SCP）优化器的基于 Transformer 的热启动。控制器使用包含弹性缆索的耦合力学模型，以及悬挂载荷的双摆表示。其表述包括移动分块控制输入、有限差分灵敏度、约束二次子问题和输入可行性投影。在专家 SCP 解上训练的 Transformer 预测初始控制序列，随后由与传统方法相同的优化器进行细化。数值实验在相同控制器设置下比较零初始化、移位初始化和 Transformer 初始化。对于独立求解的 MPC 问题，Transformer 初始化相对于零初始化减少了计算时间。然而，在序列闭环仿真中，对前一优化控制序列进行移位可提供最低的计算时间，而三种方法产生相似的跟踪行为。这些发现强调，将学习到的热启动与复用先前 MPC 解的传统初始化方法进行比较很重要。测得的优化时间超过控制采样周期；因此，未展示实时实现。关键词：模型预测控制；序列凸规划；Transformer；热启动；缆索悬挂载荷；多旋翼无人机。

items.title_en: TAT-Det: A Dataset for Testicular Appendage Torsion Detection and Segmentation in Ultrasound Images
items.title_zh: TAT-Det：用于超声图像中睾丸附件扭转检测与分割的数据集
items.abstract_en: Background: Testicular appendage torsion (TAT) is the leading cause of acute scrotal pain in prepubertal children. Yet, its diagnosis remains challenging due to nonspecific clinical manifestations and the absence of standardized datasets for pediatric acute scrotal emergencies. Results: We present TAT-Det, an expert-annotated ultrasound dataset specifically designed for TAT. TAT-Det comprises 2,600 ultrasound images from 1,203 patients collected at the Children's Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine. Each TAT-positive image is accompanied by lesion-level bounding boxes for detection and pixel-level segmentation masks for fine-grained delineation. Annotations were produced through a multi-stage workflow involving independent annotation by board-certified pediatric sonographers, consensus review, and refinement. Baseline benchmarks for object detection and semantic segmentation using representative deep learning models are further provided, with YOLO11m achieving the best detection performance and RWKV-UNet the best segmentation performance. Conclusions: TAT-Det addresses the lack of publicly available resources for pediatric emergency ultrasound and establishes a foundation for developing and evaluating artificial intelligence methods for automated TAT analysis.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：睾丸附件扭转（TAT）是青春期前儿童急性阴囊疼痛的主要原因。然而，由于临床表现非特异且缺乏针对儿童急性阴囊急症的标准化数据集，其诊断仍具挑战性。结果：我们提出 TAT-Det，一个专为 TAT 设计的专家标注超声数据集。TAT-Det 包含来自浙江大学医学院附属儿童医院收集的 1,203 名患者的 2,600 张超声图像。每张 TAT 阳性图像均配有用于检测的病灶级边界框和用于细粒度勾画的像素级分割掩膜。标注通过多阶段工作流程产生，包括由委员会认证的儿科超声医师独立标注、共识审查和细化。进一步提供了使用代表性深度学习模型进行目标检测和语义分割的基线基准，其中 YOLO11m 取得最佳检测性能，RWKV-UNet 取得最佳分割性能。结论：TAT-Det 解决了儿科急诊超声缺乏公开可用资源的问题，并为开发和评估用于自动化 TAT 分析的人工智能方法奠定了基础。

items.title_en: SHANK3-actin cytoskeleton coupling regulates nanoscale remodelling of the postsynaptic density
items.title_zh: SHANK3-肌动蛋白细胞骨架偶联调控突触后致密区的纳米尺度重塑
items.abstract_en: Dynamic remodelling of multiprotein signalling complexes allows cells to rapidly adapt signalling strength. At synapses, neurotransmitter receptors and scaffolds concentrate in subsynaptic nanoclusters that govern synaptic signalling strength and that are dynamically remodelled by synaptic activity. However, although this distinct nanoscale organization of synaptic protein complexes is well-established, the mechanisms that control the activity-induced reorganization of these complexes remain elusive. Here, to resolve the mechanisms underlying the activity-induced spatiotemporal reorganization of the PSD, we combined CRISPR/Cas9-mediated tagging of endogenous synaptic proteins and quantitative super-resolution microscopy. We found that synaptic potentiation drives a rapid and long-lasting increase in the number and density of PSD scaffold nanoclusters. Strikingly, activity-induced reorganization of scaffold proteins originated in deep PSD layers and preceded AMPA receptor repositioning, indicating that newly recruited receptors populate preformed scaffold nanoclusters. Computational simulations support that this reorganization is sufficient to drive potentiation of synaptic responses. Mechanistically, we found that the interaction between the scaffold SHANK3 and the actin cytoskeleton is essential for activity-induced PSD nanocluster remodelling. Altogether, our findings present a novel mechanism through which cytoskeletal interactions remodel the spatial organization of the PSD, advancing our understanding of how the dynamic nanoscale reorganization of protein complexes can drive neuronal signalling.
items.abstract_zh: 多蛋白信号复合物的动态重塑使细胞能够快速适应信号强度。在突触中，神经递质受体和支架蛋白集中于突触下纳米簇，这些纳米簇控制突触信号强度，并受突触活动动态重塑。然而，尽管突触蛋白复合物的这种独特纳米尺度组织已得到充分确立，但控制这些复合物活动诱导重组的机制仍不清楚。在此，为解析 PSD 活动诱导时空重组背后的机制，我们结合了 CRISPR/Cas9 介导的内源性突触蛋白标记和定量超分辨显微镜。我们发现，突触增强驱动 PSD 支架纳米簇数量和密度快速且持久地增加。引人注目的是，活动诱导的支架蛋白重组起源于 PSD 深层，并先于 AMPA 受体重新定位，表明新招募的受体填充到预先形成的支架纳米簇中。计算模拟支持这种重组足以驱动突触反应的增强。在机制上，我们发现支架蛋白 SHANK3 与肌动蛋白细胞骨架之间的相互作用对活动诱导的 PSD 纳米簇重塑至关重要。总之，我们的发现提出了一种新机制，即细胞骨架相互作用重塑 PSD 的空间组织，从而推进了对蛋白复合物动态纳米尺度重组如何驱动神经元信号的理解。

items.title_en: Complementary mechanisms of critical quantum metrology
items.title_zh: 临界量子计量学的互补机制
items.abstract_en: Critical metrology conventionally exploits enhanced susceptibility to a system parameter near a phase transition. Here we identify a complementary mechanism for critically enhanced estimation of intrinsic system parameters via suppressed quantum noise rather than enhanced response. We demonstrate both mechanisms in coherently radiating spin states (CRSS)-correlated states of $N$ spin-$1/2$ particles defined as asymptotic eigenstates of the collective-spin lowering operator with complex eigenvalue $r e^{-i\varphi}$. At the critical value $r=1$, CRSS exhibit a second-order transition. We show that near criticality, estimation of $r$ benefits from enhanced susceptibility despite increased noise, whereas estimation of $\varphi$ benefits from suppressed quantum noise without enhanced response. Remarkably, both yield the same estimation error $\sim N^{-2/3}$, improving over the standard quantum limit $N^{-1/2}$. For $\varphi$, this establishes quantum-enhanced metrology of phases intrinsic to the critical system, rather than phases externally encoded by interferometry. We demonstrate these results for CRSS realizations in both dissipative (superradiant) and Hamiltonian (Ising) systems relevant to cavity QED and trapped ions, where fast preparation of CRSS is shown possible thanks to gap opening. Applications to metrology of coupling rates and phases or optical lengths are discussed.
items.abstract_zh: 临界计量学传统上利用相变附近对系统参数的增强敏感性。在这里，我们识别出一种互补机制，用于通过抑制量子噪声而非增强响应来临界增强对本征系统参数的估计。我们在相干辐射自旋态（CRSS）关联态中展示了这两种机制，这些态由 N 个自旋-1/2 粒子定义，是集体自旋降算符的渐近本征态，具有复本征值 r e^{-iφ}。在临界值 r=1 处，CRSS 表现出二阶相变。我们表明，在临界附近，对 r 的估计受益于增强的敏感性，尽管噪声增加；而对 φ 的估计受益于抑制的量子噪声，而没有增强的响应。值得注意的是，两者都给出相同的估计误差 ∼N^{-2/3}，优于标准量子极限 N^{-1/2}。对于 φ，这建立了对临界系统本征相位的量子增强计量，而不是通过干涉测量外部编码的相位。我们在耗散（超辐射）和哈密顿（Ising）系统中的 CRSS 实现中展示了这些结果，这些系统与腔 QED 和囚禁离子相关，并表明由于能隙打开，CRSS 的快速制备是可能的。讨论了对耦合速率和相位或光学长度的计量的应用。

items.title_en: A gene informed benchmark for BioScoring of pathology foundation models
items.title_zh: 用于病理基础模型 BioScoring 的基因信息基准
items.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models are usually compared by their performance on downstream tasks such as classification and retrieval. While such benchmarks measure how useful a model is, they provide no insight into the biology it represents. We introduce BioScore, a benchmark that quantifies how well an image encoder captures cell identities, with spatial transcriptomics of the same tissue as the reference. A sparse autoencoder splits the encoder's patch embeddings into sparse features, which we cluster into a fixed number of groups. BioScore then measures, for each of 52 cell identities defined by marker genes, how specifically one group follows the identity's expression over the tissue. Because the autoencoder training is fully unsupervised, a match shows that the model represents the cell identity from the image alone. We score 8 pathology foundation models and 3 natural-image models. Every pathology model scores above every natural-image model (0.299--0.371 \vs 0.214--0.232), and paired tests separate three tiers among the pathology models. Unlike a supervised probe, BioScore needs no labels, builds its reference from the data and scores even from few sections, yet it ranks the encoders as a probe does. Its per-identity breakdown indicates which cell identities each encoder captures or misses.
items.abstract_zh: 病理基础模型通常通过其在分类和检索等下游任务上的性能进行比较。虽然此类基准衡量模型的实用性，但它们无法洞察模型所代表的生物学。我们推出 BioScore，这是一个以同一组织的空间转录组学为参考，量化图像编码器捕获细胞身份程度的基准。稀疏自编码器将编码器的 patch 嵌入拆分为稀疏特征，我们将其聚类为固定数量的组。然后，BioScore 针对由标记基因定义的 52 种细胞身份中的每一种，测量某一组在组织上跟随该身份表达的特异性。由于自编码器训练完全无监督，匹配表明模型仅从图像就表示了该细胞身份。我们对 8 个病理基础模型和 3 个自然图像模型进行评分。每个病理模型的得分都高于每个自然图像模型（0.299–0.371 对 0.214–0.232），配对检验将病理模型分为三个层级。与监督探针不同，BioScore 不需要标签，从数据构建参考，甚至仅凭少量切片即可评分，但它仍像探针一样对编码器进行排名。其按身份的分项分解表明每个编码器捕获或遗漏了哪些细胞身份。

items.title_en: Puzzling-Bench: Evaluating Language Models on 23,777 Human-Written Puzzles with Community-Verified Answers
items.title_zh: Puzzling-Bench：在 23,777 个由社区验证答案的人类撰写谜题上评估语言模型
items.abstract_en: We introduce Puzzling-Bench, a benchmark of 23,777 puzzles with community-verified answers drawn from the Puzzling Stack Exchange archive (2014-2026): riddles, ciphers, logic grids, lateral-thinking problems, wordplay and recreational mathematics, a third of them with images. Every puzzle carries the answer accepted by its author, a short reference answer taken from it (LLM-extracted for the evaluation sets and checked on a 50-puzzle human review), the author's own hints, community tags and a creation date, so that the benchmark supports hint ablations, category analysis and a rolling post-cutoff slice (254 puzzles posted after the training cutoff of six of the nine models we evaluate, including the best one) as a contamination check. We evaluate nine frontier and open models with a two-tier scorer (normalized exact match, then an LLM judge) and validate the judge with three judges from two model families: they agree on 95-97% of verdicts (kappa 0.82-0.96), move no model by more than 1.6 points, and show no own-family preference. The best model, GPT-6.1, reaches 74.8% on a shared 255-puzzle set; a hard core of 17 puzzles defeats all nine models; model failures are strongly correlated, and the second-best model contributes a single puzzle to a greedy ensemble, yet an oracle over all nine reaches 91%. On a 100-puzzle multimodal pilot, withholding the question's image costs the two best models 24 and 35 points. We release the dataset, the scoring pipeline and all per-row provenance.
items.abstract_zh: 我们推出 Puzzling-Bench，这是一个包含 23,777 个谜题的基准，答案经社区验证，取自 Puzzling Stack Exchange 档案（2014–2026）：谜语、密码、逻辑网格、横向思维问题、文字游戏和娱乐数学，其中三分之一带有图像。每个谜题都带有其作者接受的答案、从中提取的简短参考答案（评估集由 LLM 提取，并在 50 个谜题的人工审查中检查）、作者自己的提示、社区标签和创建日期，因此该基准支持提示消融、类别分析以及滚动截止后切片（254 个谜题发布于我们所评估的九个模型中六个模型（包括最佳模型）的训练截止之后）作为污染检查。我们使用两级评分器（归一化精确匹配，然后 LLM 评判）评估九个前沿和开源模型，并用来自两个模型家族的三个评判者验证评判器：它们在 95–97% 的判定上一致（kappa 0.82–0.96），没有使任何模型变动超过 1.6 分，并且没有表现出自身家族偏好。最佳模型 GPT-6.1 在共享的 255 个谜题集上达到 74.8%；一个由 17 个谜题组成的困难核心击败了所有九个模型；模型失败高度相关，第二好的模型只向贪心集成贡献了一个谜题，但对所有九个模型的 oracle 达到 91%。在一个 100 个谜题的多模态试点中，不给问题图像使两个最佳模型分别损失 24 和 35 分。我们发布数据集、评分流程以及所有逐行来源信息。

items.title_en: MRCT: An Object-Centric Two-Layer Control Architecture for Heavy-Payload Multi-Robot Transportation
items.title_zh: MRCT：一种以对象为中心的两层控制架构，用于重载多机器人运输
items.abstract_en: Cooperative transportation of heavy payloads by heterogeneous mobile manipulators requires coordinated payload motion, force distribution, and compliant physical interaction. This paper presents MRCT, an object-centric two-layer control architecture for multi-robot transportation. At the object level, a model predictive controller (MPC) generates a coordinated contact-force reference for the payload. At the robot level, whole- body impedance control (WBIC) modules on individual robots realise the reference through a confidence-based blending of velocity-tracking and impedance torques. The blending mechanism emphasises tracking when the joint-velocity error is small and increases compliance when tracking degrades because of abrupt reference changes or physical disturbances. Simulation and hardware experiments with a heterogeneous team comprising a single-arm and a dual-arm mobile manipulator transporting a near-rated table payload demonstrate accurate object tracking, regulated contact forces, and stable payload orientation. Parameter sensitivity studies, obstacle-avoidance transportation, and step-load disturbance experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of MRCT for reliable cooperative transportation under the evaluated conditions
items.abstract_zh: 由异构移动操作手协同运输重型负载需要协调的负载运动、力分配和柔顺的物理交互。本文提出 MRCT，一种用于多机器人运输的以对象为中心的两层控制架构。在对象层，模型预测控制器（MPC）为负载生成协调的接触力参考。在机器人层，各个机器人上的全身阻抗控制（WBIC）模块通过基于置信度的速度跟踪和阻抗力矩混合来实现该参考。该混合机制在关节速度误差较小时强调跟踪，并在由于参考突变或物理扰动导致跟踪退化时增加柔顺性。使用由单臂和双臂移动操作手组成的异构团队运输接近额定值的桌面负载的仿真和硬件实验表明，对象跟踪准确、接触力受调节且负载姿态稳定。参数敏感性研究、避障运输和阶跃负载扰动实验进一步证明了 MRCT 在所评估条件下实现可靠协同运输的有效性。

items.title_en: Reading, Not Adapting: Unlocking Frozen Visual Knowledge for AI-Generated Image Detection
items.title_zh: 读取而非适配：解锁冻结视觉知识用于AI生成图像检测
items.abstract_en: Generalization to unseen image generators has driven efforts to adapt pretrained visual representations for detection. Yet recent findings show that vision foundation models already encode transferable detection knowledge, while further adaptation can impair generalization. This motivates a shift from backbone adaptation to knowledge readout. Conventional linear probing offers a direct way to read this knowledge but is limited to final-layer RGB features. Multi-cue detectors broaden the evidence base, but their designs introduce other tradeoffs: adaptation may compromise pretrained transferability, heterogeneous encoders complicate feature integration, and late fusion precludes intermediate cross-view interaction. To overcome these limitations, we propose ReMoT, a Mixture-of-Transformers-inspired framework that reads complementary knowledge from spatially aligned RGB and wavelet views within a fully frozen visual foundation. ReMoT employs staged joint attention to enable controlled local and global cross-view interaction, while learnable fusion queries progressively read complementary evidence across Transformer depth without writeback. ReMoT achieves 91.2% average accuracy across eight benchmark groups with 3,074 trainable parameters, attaining the highest overall average among the evaluated methods. These results support structured knowledge readout as a promising alternative to backbone adaptation. Code is available at https://github.com/yunncheng/ReMoT.
items.abstract_zh: 对未见图像生成器的泛化推动了将预训练视觉表示适配用于检测的努力。然而，近期发现表明，视觉基础模型已经编码了可迁移的检测知识，而进一步适配可能损害泛化。这促使从骨干适配转向知识读取。传统线性探测提供了读取该知识的直接方式，但受限于最终层RGB特征。多线索检测器拓宽了证据基础，但其设计引入了其他权衡：适配可能损害预训练可迁移性，异构编码器使特征整合复杂化，晚期融合排除了中间跨视图交互。为克服这些局限，我们提出ReMoT，一个受Mixture-of-Transformers启发的框架，在完全冻结的视觉基础模型内从空间对齐的RGB和小波视图读取互补知识。ReMoT采用分阶段联合注意力，以实现受控的局部和全局跨视图交互，同时可学习的融合查询在Transformer深度上逐步读取互补证据，且不回写。ReMoT在八个基准组上以3,074个可训练参数达到91.2%的平均准确率，在所评估方法中取得最高总体平均值。这些结果支持结构化知识读取作为骨干适配的有前景替代方案。代码见 https://github.com/yunncheng/ReMoT。

items.title_en: Exercise misinformation in fitness content targeted at women on Instagram and TikTok: a cross-sectional content analysis of 6,982 posts
items.title_zh: Instagram 和 TikTok 上针对女性的健身内容中的运动错误信息：对 6,982 条帖子的横断面内容分析
items.abstract_en: ObjectivesTo quantify exercise misinformation in female-targeted exercise content on Instagram and TikTok, determine whether content textually targeted at women carries higher rates of misinformation, and compare content from creators self-identifying as ethnic minority with other content. MethodsCross-sectional content analysis of 6,982 posts collected March to June 2026 by manual browsing, which captured on-screen and caption text, and automated collection, which captured captions only. Text was coded for claim accuracy, textual female targeting and creator characteristics, with large language model-assisted coding verified against an independent human coder. Effects were estimated by logistic regression using adjustment sets from a pre-specified causal diagram, with creator-clustered standard errors. ResultsOf 6,524 posts, 2,447 made an assessable exercise claim, of which 600 (24.5%, 95% CI 22.8 to 26.2) contained misinformation. Textually female-targeted content carried more than twice the odds of misinformation compared with untargeted content (OR 2.06, 95% CI 1.58 to 2.70), particularly wholly inaccurate content. The effect was OR 4.00 (2.41 to 6.66) where on-screen text was captured and 1.04 (0.73 to 1.49) where only captions were (interaction p < 0.001). Content from creators self-identifying as ethnic minority carried less misinformation (OR 0.69, 95% CI 0.51 to 0.92). Conclusion24.5% of fitness posts making a verifiable claim contained misinformation, and content directed at women had higher rates where the full written text could be read. Posts naming a body part were most likely to be inaccurate, giving clinicians and public health communicators a teachable marker of misinformation. Key messages What is already known on this topicO_LIHealth misinformation is common on social media, and fitness content aimed at women has been linked to harmful impacts on mood, body image and exercise behaviour. C_LIO_LIExisting research concentrates on YouTube or small samples, is rarely gender-specific, and contains no ethnic minority sub-analyses. C_LI What this study addsO_LIOne in four posts making a verifiable exercise claim contained misinformation, and textually female-targeted content carried more than twice the odds of untargeted content -- four times the odds where on-screen text (in addition to caption text) could be read. C_LIO_LIContent directed at women implicitly, by naming a body part, carried higher odds of misinformation than content explicitly addressing a female audience, and was more likely to be wholly inaccurate. C_LIO_LIContent from creators self-identifying as ethnic minority carried less misinformation, not more. C_LI How this study might affect research, practice or policyO_LIWomen navigate a measurably worse exercise information environment on social media, and the misinformation directed at them is disproportionately about altering body shape rather than enhancing their capability; this framing is already linked to negative biopsychosocial effects on women. C_LIO_LIGiven the content with the highest odds of being wholly inaccurate never addresses women directly, advice and policy aimed at explicitly gendered marketing will miss most of it; appraisal must be based on what a post claims, not on whom it addresses. C_LIO_LIClinicians have a usable rule: content naming a body part and promising a shape warrants scepticism; content describing a practice and a capability warrants less. The element most likely to be false is the promised outcome, not the exercise. C_LIO_LICommercial intent and self-described "coach" status are weak discriminators of misinformation and should not be regarded? as warning signs. C_LI
items.abstract_zh: 目的：量化 Instagram 和 TikTok 上针对女性的运动内容中的运动错误信息，判断文本上针对女性的内容是否具有更高的错误信息率，并比较自我认同为少数族裔的创作者内容与其他内容。方法：对2026年3月至6月收集的6,982条帖子进行横断面内容分析；人工浏览捕获屏幕文字和配文，自动收集仅捕获配文。对文本按主张准确性、文本层面的女性针对性和创作者特征进行编码，并使用大语言模型辅助编码，且由独立人工编码者验证。采用逻辑回归估计效应，调整集来自预先指定的因果图，并使用以创作者为聚类单位的聚类标准误。结果：在6,524条帖子中，2,447条提出了可评估的运动主张，其中600条（24.5%，95% CI 22.8至26.2）包含错误信息。文本上针对女性的内容相比未针对性内容，其错误信息优势比超过两倍（OR 2.06，95% CI 1.58至2.70），尤其是完全不准的内容。在捕获屏幕文字时，效应为 OR 4.00（2.41至6.66）；在仅捕获配文时为1.04（0.73至1.49）（交互作用 p < 0.001）。自我认同为少数族裔的创作者内容携带的错误信息较少（OR 0.69，95% CI 0.51至0.92）。结论：24.5%作出可验证主张的健身帖子包含错误信息，且在可读取完整书面文本时，面向女性的内容错误信息率更高。点名身体部位的帖子最可能不准确，这为临床医生和公共卫生传播者提供了一个可教学的错误信息识别标志。关键信息——本主题已知内容：健康错误信息在社交媒体上很常见，面向女性的健身内容与对情绪、身体意象和运动行为的有害影响相关。现有研究集中于 YouTube 或小样本，很少按性别区分，且不包含少数族裔亚组分析。本研究新增内容：四分之一作出可验证运动主张的帖子包含错误信息，文本上针对女性的内容其错误信息优势比是未针对性内容的两倍以上——在可读取屏幕文字（除配文外）时达到四倍优势比。通过点名身体部位隐性面向女性的内容，其错误信息优势比高于明确面向女性受众的内容，且更可能完全不准。自我认同为少数族裔的创作者内容携带的错误信息更少，而非更多。本研究可能如何影响研究、实践或政策：女性在社交媒体上面对的运动信息环境可测量地更差，且针对她们的错误信息不成比例地关乎改变体型而非提升其能力；这种框架已与对女性的负面生物心理社会影响相关。鉴于完全不准优势比最高的内容从未直接面向女性，针对明确性别化营销的建议和政策将错过其中大部分内容；评估必须基于帖子主张了什么，而不是它面向谁。临床医生有一条可用规则：点名身体部位并承诺某种体型的内容值得怀疑；描述一种做法和能力的内容则较不值得怀疑。最可能为假的是承诺的结果，而不是运动本身。商业意图和自述“教练”身份是错误信息的弱判别因素，不应被视为警示信号。

items.title_en: Exact monogamy of steering and remote Wigner negativity for multimode Gaussian nodes
items.title_zh: 多模高斯节点的导引与远程Wigner负性的精确一夫一妻性
items.abstract_en: Optical quantum networks route correlations through nodes that hold several modes and are linked to many neighbors. Steering is the correlation behind one-sided device-independent tasks and behind the remote preparation of non-Gaussian states. It is monogamous for a single mode, which can be steered by only one party, but how many neighbors can steer a node with $k$ modes was not known. We show that for Gaussian states the answer is exactly $2k-1$ when the neighbors use Gaussian measurements, with any number of measurement settings. The limit follows from a simple bound. To every neighbor we assign a share, computed from the covariance matrix, and we prove that the shares of all neighbors add up to at most $k$, irrespective of the amount of squeezing, amplification or noise the network contains. A neighbor steers the node by Gaussian measurements exactly when its share exceeds one half, and a network built from a harmonic tight frame reaches the limit. The same number governs remote Wigner negativity. A heralded non-Gaussian operation at the node can make at most $2k-1$ neighbors Wigner negative, and in our network a single heralded projection makes all of them negative in the same run. With $n$ settings of arbitrary measurements, at most $nk-1$ neighbors can steer the node or violate a Bell inequality with it. More than $2k-1$ neighbors can therefore steer the node or violate a Bell inequality with it only if they use non-Gaussian measurements with at least three settings, whereas entanglement can reach any number of neighbors. These results determine exactly how many neighbors one multimode node can serve with steering and with remote Wigner negativity.
items.abstract_zh: 光量子网络通过持有多个模式并连接许多邻居的节点来路由关联。导引是单边设备无关任务以及非高斯态远程制备背后的关联。对于单个模式，它具有一夫一妻性，只能被一方导引；但对于具有 $k$ 个模式的节点，能被多少邻居导引尚不清楚。我们表明，对于高斯态，当邻居使用高斯测量时，答案恰好为 $2k-1$，且测量设置数任意。该极限来自一个简单界。我们为每个邻居分配一个份额，由协方差矩阵计算，并证明所有邻居的份额之和至多为 $k$，无论网络包含多少压缩、放大或噪声。一个邻居通过高斯测量导引该节点，当且仅当其份额超过二分之一；由调和紧框架构建的网络可达到该极限。同一数目支配远程Wigner负性。节点处的预报型非高斯操作至多可使 $2k-1$ 个邻居呈Wigner负性，而在我们的网络中，单次预报型投影可在同一次运行中使所有这些邻居呈负性。使用任意测量的 $n$ 个设置时，至多有 $nk-1$ 个邻居能够导引该节点或与其违反Bell不等式。因此，超过 $2k-1$ 个邻居只有在使用至少三个设置的非高斯测量时，才能导引该节点或与其违反Bell不等式；而纠缠可达到任意数量的邻居。这些结果精确确定了一个多模节点在导引和远程Wigner负性方面可服务多少邻居。

items.title_en: Cell-Type-Specific Expression Is Hard to Predict from Bulk, but It Is Still Useful
items.title_zh: 细胞类型特异性表达难以从批量数据预测，但仍然有用
items.abstract_en: Single-cell-informed deconvolution provides cell-type-resolved features for clinical bulk RNA cohorts. Most existing methods predict the proportions $π_k$ of the $K$ constituent cell types (CTs). Fewer predict cell-type-specific expression (CTSE) $μ_{kg}$ of gene $g$ in CT $k$, which can capture cell states that proportions miss, but recent benchmarks find it much harder. We explain this gap with closed-form accuracy bounds. For CTSE, we derive an $R^2$ ceiling for per-gene linear estimators. For proportions, the best linear estimator, which pools evidence across genes, has a closed-form $R^2$, and a computable lower bound on it predicts which CTs are learnable. We study targeted deconvolution of 106 biologically curated (CT, gene) pairs, found post hoc to have higher learnability scores. On overall survival in non-small cell lung cancer, estimation difficulty does not predict prognostic value across these targets. Yet a sparse survival model on deconvolved features, mostly CTSE, predicts survival as well as a sparse model on the bulk genes themselves, while attributing its signal to specific cell types. Some deconvolved CTSE features reveal prognostic signal not seen in the corresponding bulk gene.
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞信息启发的去卷积为临床批量RNA队列提供细胞类型解析特征。现有大多数方法预测 $K$ 个组成细胞类型（CT）的比例 $π_k$。较少方法预测基因 $g$ 在CT $k$ 中的细胞类型特异性表达（CTSE）$μ_{kg}$，这能捕获比例遗漏的细胞状态，但近期基准发现其难度大得多。我们用闭式精度界解释这一差距。对于CTSE，我们推导出逐基因线性估计器的 $R^2$ 上限。对于比例，跨基因汇集证据的最佳线性估计器具有闭式 $R^2$，其可计算下界可预测哪些CT可学习。我们研究了106个经生物学策展的（CT，基因）对的靶向去卷积，这些对事后被发现具有更高的可学习性得分。在非小细胞肺癌的总生存期上，估计难度并不能预测这些靶标的预后价值。然而，一个基于去卷积特征（主要是CTSE）的稀疏生存模型，其预测生存的能力与基于批量基因本身的稀疏模型相当，同时将其信号归因于特定细胞类型。一些去卷积的CTSE特征揭示了相应批量基因中未见到的预后信号。
